accountMenu.connected: Where: account menu (opened by clicking the AniList / MyAnimeList logo in the status bar at the bottom of the popup and of the side panel), grey status line under the service name, after a green dot. Shown only when the user's profile name could not be loaded. Meaning: this account is connected to SyncKai. Length: short (≤ 16 chars).
accountMenu.connectedAs: Where: account menu (opened by clicking the AniList / MyAnimeList logo in the status bar of the popup and of the side panel), grey status line under the service name, after a green dot. Placeholders: {name} = the user's AniList / MyAnimeList user name (e.g. 'Kai_fan'). Meaning: this account is connected to SyncKai. Length: short (one line, truncated with … if too long). Notes: keep ' · '; same wording as settings.account.connected, with the user name instead of the service.
accountMenu.label: Where: status bar at the bottom of the popup and of the side panel, screen-reader label and tooltip of the round AniList / MyAnimeList logo button; also the accessible name of the account menu it opens. Placeholders: {service} = AniList or MyAnimeList. Meaning: the user's account on that service (clicking opens its menu: profile, stats, disconnect). Length: short (tooltip).
accountMenu.labelExpired: Where: same logo button as accountMenu.label (status bar of the popup and side panel), when the session has expired (greyed logo, red dot). Placeholders: {service} = AniList or MyAnimeList. Meaning: the user's account on that service, whose session expired (the menu offers « Reconnect »). Length: short (tooltip). Notes: same 'session expired' wording as common.sessionExpired.
accountMenu.profile: Where: account menu of the status bar (popup and side panel), menu item with a person icon and an external-link arrow. Meaning: opens the user's profile page on AniList / MyAnimeList in a new tab. Length: short (≤ 24 chars).
accountMenu.stats.anime_one: Where: account menu of the status bar (popup and side panel), small grey label under a big number in the first of three stat tiles (e.g. '142' over 'anime'). Meaning: number of anime in the user's list on that service, 'Plan to watch' excluded. The number is shown separately above: the text has no {count}; use the noun form that agrees with the count. Length: very short (≤ 10 chars; three tiles share ≈ 280 px).
accountMenu.stats.anime_other: Plural form of accountMenu.stats.anime_one (label under '142' in the first stat tile of the account menu). No {count}: the number is shown above. Length: very short (≤ 10 chars).
accountMenu.stats.days_one: Where: account menu of the status bar (popup and side panel), small grey label under the third stat tile's value (accountMenu.stats.daysValue, e.g. '54 d' over 'watched'). Meaning: total time the user spent watching anime, in days, as computed by AniList / MyAnimeList. No {count}: the value is shown above; agree with 'days' if your language needs it. Length: very short (≤ 10 chars).
accountMenu.stats.days_other: Plural form of accountMenu.stats.days_one (label under '54 d' in the third stat tile of the account menu). No {count}. Length: very short (≤ 10 chars).
accountMenu.stats.daysValue: Where: account menu of the status bar (popup and side panel), big number of the third stat tile, above accountMenu.stats.days_*. Placeholders: {days} = number of days watched, already formatted in the language's number format (e.g. '54', '2.5'). Meaning: total watch time in days. Length: very short. Notes: abbreviated unit, like 'min' and 'h' elsewhere (French 'j', German 'T'); use the language's usual short form for 'day'.
accountMenu.stats.episodes_one: Where: account menu of the status bar (popup and side panel), small grey label under the big number of the second stat tile (e.g. '3,210' over 'episodes'). Meaning: total number of episodes the user watched, as counted by AniList / MyAnimeList. No {count}: the number is shown above; use the noun form that agrees with it. Length: very short (≤ 10 chars).
accountMenu.stats.episodes_other: Plural form of accountMenu.stats.episodes_one (label under '3,210' in the second stat tile of the account menu). No {count}. Length: very short (≤ 10 chars).
accountMenu.week.label: Where: account menu of the status bar (popup and side panel), one-line row with a green check, below the three stat tiles; the value (accountMenu.week.value_*) is on the right of the same line. Meaning: episodes that SyncKai synced to this service during the current week (Monday to Sunday). Length: short (≈ 22 chars): it is truncated with … if the line is too narrow, and accountMenu.week.title gives the full meaning in a tooltip. Notes: same 'sync' word as the rest of the UI.
accountMenu.week.title: Where: tooltip of accountMenu.week.label in the account menu of the status bar (popup and side panel). Meaning: the full meaning of that short label: episodes synced by SyncKai to this service during the current week (Monday to Sunday). Length: medium (tooltip, one sentence without final period).
accountMenu.week.value_one: Where: account menu of the status bar (popup and side panel), bold value at the right end of the « Synced this week » row (accountMenu.week.label). Placeholders: {count} = number of episodes synced this week (0 or more). Meaning: e.g. '9 episodes'. Length: short (≈ 12 chars): it never wraps; the label on its left is truncated instead.
accountMenu.week.value_other: Plural form of accountMenu.week.value_one (e.g. '9 episodes', right end of the « Synced this week » row of the account menu). Placeholders: {count} = number of episodes. Length: short (≈ 12 chars, never wraps).
agenda.adjust: Where: side panel › Schedule tab › '⋯' menu of an episode row, menu item (clock icon). Meaning: opens an inline editor to set this series' delay between the Japanese broadcast and its release on the streaming platform. Length: short (≤ 22 chars). Notes: action label (verb). Quoted in agenda.estimate.title: keep both identical.
agenda.adjust.custom: Where: side panel › Schedule tab › '⋯' menu of an episode row, second line of the 'Adjust time' item, after the estimated time and platform ('19:45 Netflix · set for this series'). Meaning: this series has its own delay, set by the user (unlike agenda.adjust.default). Length: short, wraps under the item. Notes: lower case where the language has case (it follows ' · '); same idea as the parenthesis of agenda.estimate.custom.
agenda.adjust.default: Where: side panel › Schedule tab › '⋯' menu of an episode row, second line of the 'Adjust time' item, after the estimated time and platform ('18:00 Crunchyroll · default delay'). Meaning: the time uses the platform's delay from Settings › Platforms, not a delay set for this series. Length: short. Notes: lower case where the language has case (it follows ' · '); 'delay' = same word as agenda.adjust.label.
agenda.adjust.help: Where: side panel › Schedule tab › per-series delay editor, help line under the minutes field. Meaning: the value is how many minutes after the Japanese TV broadcast the episode is released on the platform (negative = before). Placeholders: {min} = -1440, {max} = 10080, written in the language's number format (minus sign, digit grouping: '-1,440', '10,080'). Length: medium, wraps.
agenda.adjust.label: Where: side panel › Schedule tab › per-series delay editor, label of the minutes input. Meaning: delay between the Japanese broadcast and the platform release, for this series only. Placeholders: {title} = anime title, e.g. 'Dandadan'. Length: medium, wraps.
agenda.adjust.platform: Where: side panel › Schedule tab › per-series delay editor, line under the minutes field when the value typed equals the platform's delay. Meaning: release on the platform = Japanese broadcast + that delay. Placeholders: {platform} = e.g. Netflix; {offset} = signed delay built from time.countdown.hours and time.countdown.minutes, e.g. '+1 h', '+1 h 30 min'. Length: medium, wraps. Notes: first sentence of agenda.estimate.title, keep both identical.
agenda.adjust.reset: Where: side panel › Schedule tab › per-series delay editor, button shown only when this series has its own delay. Meaning: remove the series' custom delay so the platform's default delay (Settings) applies again. Length: short (≤ 12 chars), next to Save and Cancel.
agenda.adjust.save: Where: side panel › Schedule tab › per-series delay editor, primary button. Meaning: save the delay typed in the minutes field. Length: short (≤ 12 chars), shares a row with the input, 'Default' and 'Cancel'. Notes: imperative verb.
agenda.adjust.saveFailed: Where: side panel › Schedule tab › per-series delay editor, red error line replacing the help text (announced to screen readers). Meaning: the delay could not be saved; the user should try again. Length: medium. Notes: informal tone (FR « tu », DE « du »).
agenda.day.none: Where: side panel › Schedule tab, muted text at the right of a day heading (e.g. 'Tuesday 14') when that day has no releases. Meaning: none of the user's series airs an episode that day. Length: short (≤ 20 chars).
agenda.day.today: Where: side panel › Schedule tab, small outlined badge next to today's day heading. Meaning: marks the current day. Length: very short (≤ 10 chars, tiny pill). Notes: same English as agenda.today, which is a navigation button.
agenda.empty.noSeries: Where: side panel › Schedule tab, empty-state card text. Meaning: the user's AniList/MyAnimeList 'Watching' list is empty; once they start watching a series on a streaming site, its weekly releases appear here. Length: long, wraps (≤ 280 px). Notes: Crunchyroll, ADN untranslated; FR « tu ».
agenda.empty.noSeriesPlatforms: Where: side panel › Schedule tab, empty-state card (variant of agenda.empty.noSeries used when Netflix/Disney+ are enabled). Meaning: the user's 'Watching' list is empty. Placeholders: {platforms} = names joined with 'or' in the UI language, e.g. 'Crunchyroll, ADN or Netflix'. Length: long, wraps.
agenda.empty.week: Where: side panel › Schedule tab, card text. Meaning: no series in the user's 'Watching' list has an episode in the displayed week ('this week' = the week shown, which may be another week). Length: long, wraps.
agenda.episode: Where: side panel › Schedule tab › episode row, after the anime title on the same line ('Frieren · Ep. 7'). Meaning: number of the episode that airs. Placeholders: {episode} = episode number, e.g. 5 or 1156. Length: short (≤ 10 chars). Notes: 'Ep.' = abbreviation of episode; the title is cut with '…' before it.
agenda.error: Where: side panel › Schedule tab, red error card with a Retry button. Meaning: the weekly release schedule could not be loaded. Placeholders: {error} = full error sentence, e.g. 'AniList is unreachable. Check your connection.' Length: medium, wraps. Notes: 'Schedule' = the tab name (panel.tab.agenda).
agenda.estimate: Where: side panel › Schedule tab › per-series delay editor, preview right of the minutes field ('≈ [logo] 19:45'). Meaning: estimated local release time on the streaming platform with the delay typed. Placeholders: {platform} = platform name, shown as its logo on screen; {time} = local time, e.g. '18:30' or 'Sat 18:30'. Length: short. Notes: keep '≈' and both placeholders.
agenda.estimate.custom: Where: side panel › Schedule tab, tooltip (title) of the estimated time of an episode row when the user set a delay for this series, and line under the minutes field of the delay editor. Meaning: estimate = Japanese broadcast time + that delay. Placeholders: {offset} = signed delay built from time.countdown.hours and time.countdown.minutes, e.g. '+1 h', '+45 min', '+1 h 30 min', '-30 min'. Length: medium, wraps.
agenda.estimate.title: Where: side panel › Schedule tab, tooltip (title) of the estimated time. Meaning: release on the platform = Japanese broadcast + the platform's default delay. Placeholders: {platform} = e.g. Crunchyroll; {offset} = signed delay built from time.countdown.hours and time.countdown.minutes, e.g. '+1 h', '+45 min', '+1 h 30 min', '-30 min'. Notes: 'Settings' = nav.settings; “Adjust time” must match agenda.adjust.
agenda.jp: Where: side panel › Schedule tab › episode row, time line, last part ('18:00 Crunchyroll · Japan 17:00'), cut with '…' first when the line is too narrow; alone when the platform time is unknown. Meaning: time of the original TV broadcast in Japan, converted to the user's local time. Placeholders: {time} = local time, e.g. '17:30' or '5:30 PM'. Length: short. Notes: the country name, written out (no 'JP' abbreviation).
agenda.jp.title: Where: side panel › Schedule tab, tooltip (title) of the 'Japan {time}' text (agenda.jp). Meaning: this is the original broadcast time in Japan, displayed in the user's own time zone. Length: medium.
agenda.loading: Where: side panel › Schedule tab, aria-label of the loading skeleton (screen readers only). Meaning: the release schedule of the displayed week is loading. Length: medium.
agenda.menu: Where: side panel › Schedule tab › episode row, aria-label and tooltip of the icon-only '⋯' button. Meaning: opens a menu (Adjust time, Open the entry ›, Search on… ›). Placeholders: {title} = anime title, e.g. 'Dandadan'. Length: medium.
agenda.nav: Where: side panel › Schedule tab, aria-label of the week navigation group (previous/next arrows, week button that opens a month calendar, Today button on another week); screen readers only. Meaning: 'Week' as in week navigation. Length: short.
agenda.next: Where: side panel › Schedule tab, tooltip and aria-label of the icon-only '›' arrow button. Meaning: show the following week. Length: short.
agenda.notConnected: Where: side panel › Schedule tab, card text. Meaning: no AniList or MyAnimeList account is connected; accounts are connected in the extension popup (toolbar icon). Length: long, wraps. Notes: product names untranslated; FR « tu ».
agenda.openTitle: Where: side panel › Schedule tab › episode row, tooltip (title) of the 'Open' button that opens the series on a streaming site in a new tab. Placeholders: {platform} = Crunchyroll, ADN, Netflix or Disney+. Length: short.
agenda.picker.hint: Where: side panel › Schedule tab › month calendar opened from the week button, footer text next to 'This week'. Meaning: the Up and Down arrow keys move the highlighted week, the Enter key shows that week in the Schedule. Length: medium, wraps on two lines. Notes: keep the arrows '↑ ↓'; name the Enter key as the language's keyboards print it.
agenda.picker.label: Where: side panel › Schedule tab, tooltip of the week button (dates + calendar icon) and accessible name of the month calendar it opens. Meaning: pick the week to show in the Schedule. Length: short.
agenda.picker.nextMonth: Where: side panel › Schedule tab › month calendar, tooltip and aria-label of the '›' button next to the month name. Meaning: show the following month (no week is chosen yet). Length: short.
agenda.picker.prevMonth: Where: side panel › Schedule tab › month calendar, tooltip and aria-label of the '‹' button next to the month name. Meaning: show the preceding month (no week is chosen yet). Length: short.
agenda.picker.thisWeek: Where: side panel › Schedule tab › month calendar, footer button (disabled when the current week is already shown). Meaning: show the week that contains today. Length: short (≤ 16 chars).
agenda.prev: Where: side panel › Schedule tab, tooltip and aria-label of the icon-only '‹' arrow button. Meaning: show the preceding week. Length: short.
agenda.stale: Where: side panel › Schedule tab, red line above the days, with a Retry button. Meaning: refreshing failed, so the copy of the schedule saved earlier is shown. Placeholders: {error} = error sentence, e.g. 'AniList is unreachable. Check your connection.' Length: medium (11 px, wraps). Notes: keep the ' · ' separator.
agenda.today: Where: side panel › Schedule tab, button after the week navigation, shown only when another week than the current one is displayed. Meaning: jump back to the week that contains today. Length: short (≤ 12 chars; bar shared with arrows and week button). Notes: same English as agenda.day.today (a badge).
agenda.watched: Where: side panel › Schedule tab › episode row, mint text after a mint dot at the start of the time line ('● Watched · 18:00 Crunchyroll'). Meaning: the user has already watched this episode (list progress ≥ its number). Length: short (≤ 10 chars). Notes: past participle/adjective, not a verb.
airing.notification.group_one: Where: browser notification title (chrome.notifications), when several of the user's series got a new episode at the same check. Meaning: count of new episodes, then the anime titles. Placeholders: {count} = 4 or more in practice; {titles} = anime titles as a list in the UI language, e.g. 'Frieren, Dandadan and One Piece' (、 in Japanese and Chinese). Length: short title, the browser truncates long titles. Notes: plural form chosen by the number.
airing.notification.group_other: Plural form of airing.notification.group_one (same notification title). Placeholders: {count} = number of new episodes (4 or more); {titles} = anime titles as a list in the UI language ('Frieren, Dandadan and One Piece'; 、 in Japanese and Chinese). Keep it short: the browser truncates notification titles.
airing.notification.message: Where: browser system notification, body text under the title (single episode or summary). Meaning: the episode has just aired on Japanese TV; it usually appears on Crunchyroll/ADN a few hours later. Length: medium (≈ 70 chars). Notes: Crunchyroll and ADN are product names, not translated; keep the ' · ' separator.
airing.notification.single: Where: browser system notification, title line. Meaning: a new episode of a series from the user's Watching list has aired (is out). Placeholders: {episode} = episode number, e.g. 5; {title} = anime title, e.g. 'Frieren'. Length: short (the system truncates long titles). Notes: 'Ep.' = abbreviation of episode.
airing.skip.disabled: Where: Settings › Notifications › New episodes, status line, after 'Last checked: {relative} · '. Meaning: the hourly new-episode check was skipped because release alerts are turned off. Length: short. Notes: sentence fragment, lowercase start, no final period.
airing.skip.noSeries: Where: Settings › New episodes, status line, after 'Last checked: {relative} · '. Meaning: check skipped: the locally cached Watching list has no series; opening the popup's Watching tab loads it. Length: medium. Notes: fragment, lowercase start, no final period; 'Watching' = popup tab name (same term as nav.watching); informal you.
airing.skip.notConnected: Where: Settings › New episodes, status line, after 'Last checked: {relative} · '. Meaning: the check was skipped because no AniList/MyAnimeList account is signed in. Length: short. Notes: sentence fragment, lowercase start, no final period.
airing.status.failed: Where: Settings › New episodes, red status line, after 'Last checked: {relative} · '. Meaning: the last new-episode check failed. Placeholders: {error} = error text (translated API error, a technical message, or 'Unknown error'), max 160 chars. Length: short prefix. Notes: fragment, lowercase start.
airing.status.last: Where: Settings › Notifications › New episodes, status line next to the 'Check now' button. Meaning: time of the last check for newly aired episodes. Placeholders: {relative} = translated relative time (time.* keys), e.g. '5 min ago', 'yesterday', 'just now'. Length: short. Notes: usually followed by ' · ' + a result fragment.
airing.status.never: Where: Settings › Notifications › New episodes, status line next to the 'Check now' button. Meaning: no check for newly aired episodes has ever run. Length: short.
airing.status.none: Where: Settings › New episodes, status line, after 'Last checked: {relative} · '. Meaning: the last check found no newly aired episode to announce. Length: short. Notes: sentence fragment, lowercase start, no final period.
airing.status.notified_one: Where: Settings › New episodes, status line, after 'Last checked: {relative} · '. Meaning: number of new episodes announced by browser notification during the last check. Placeholders: {count} = number, e.g. 1. Length: short. Notes: plural pair (_one/_other); fragment, no final period.
airing.status.notified_other: Plural form of airing.status.notified_one (e.g. '3 episodes notified'). Where: Settings › New episodes, status line, after 'Last checked: {relative} · '. Placeholders: {count} = number of announced episodes. Length: short. Notes: fragment, no final period.
airing.unknownError: Where: Settings › New episodes, inserted as {error} in 'failed: {error}'. Meaning: fallback text when the new-episode check failed without any error message. Length: short.
api.httpError: Where: error message from the service worker, shown in popup/side panel alerts, in-page toasts ('failed: {message}') and pending-sync items. Meaning: the AniList/MyAnimeList API answered with an error. Placeholders: {service} = AniList or MyAnimeList; {status} = HTTP status code, e.g. 503. Length: short. Notes: full sentence, final period.
api.invalidAfterUpdate.anilist: Where: error message (popup/side panel alerts, in-page toasts, pending-sync items). Meaning: AniList's reply to a change of the user's list (saving progress/status or deleting the entry) was not as expected. 'Update' = this list change, NOT a software update. Length: medium. Notes: AniList is a product name.
api.invalidAfterUpdate.mal: Where: error message (popup/side panel alerts, in-page toasts, pending-sync items). Meaning: MyAnimeList's reply after saving a change to the user's list entry was not as expected. 'Update' = this list change, NOT a software update. Length: medium. Notes: MyAnimeList is a product name.
api.invalidResponse.anilist: Where: error message (popup/side panel alerts, in-page toasts, pending-sync items). Meaning: AniList's API returned data in an unexpected or malformed format. Length: short. Notes: AniList is a product name.
api.invalidResponse.mal: Where: error message (popup/side panel alerts, in-page toasts, pending-sync items, MyAnimeList sign-in). Meaning: MyAnimeList's API returned malformed/unexpected data (also when the sign-in token answer is invalid). Length: short. Notes: MyAnimeList is a product name.
api.listLoadFailed: Where: error alert in the popup's Watching tab. Meaning: unexpected internal error while loading the user's AniList/MyAnimeList Watching list (anime currently being watched). 'List' = the user's anime list. Length: medium.
api.malNotFound: Where: error message (popup alerts, in-page toasts, pending-sync items). Meaning: MyAnimeList answered 404: this anime's entry (MAL ID) does not exist on MyAnimeList. 'Entry' = the anime's page/record on the site (FR « fiche »). Length: short. Notes: MyAnimeList is a product name.
api.network: Where: error message (popup/side panel alerts, in-page toasts, pending-sync items, sign-in). Meaning: the request failed at network level (offline, service down). Placeholders: {service} = AniList or MyAnimeList. Length: medium. Notes: two sentences; imperative in informal you (FR tu, DE du).
api.notAuthenticated: Where: error message (popup/side panel alerts, toasts). Meaning: there is no valid sign-in for this service, so the request that needs the account was not sent. Placeholders: {service} = AniList or MyAnimeList. Length: short.
api.profileLoadFailed: Where: error alert on an account card (popup welcome screen, Settings › Accounts). Meaning: unexpected internal error while loading the user's AniList/MyAnimeList profile (username, avatar). Length: medium.
api.rateLimited: Where: error message (popup/side panel alerts, in-page toasts, pending-sync items). Meaning: the service's API request limit was reached (HTTP 429); wait and retry. Placeholders: {service} = AniList or MyAnimeList. Length: medium. Notes: informal you (FR tu, DE du).
api.sessionExpired: Where: error message (popup/side panel alerts, in-page toasts, pending-sync items). Meaning: the OAuth sign-in to the service is no longer valid (token expired or rejected); the user must sign in again. Placeholders: {service} = AniList or MyAnimeList. Length: medium. Notes: informal you (FR tu, DE du).
api.timeout: Where: error message (popup/side panel alerts, in-page toasts, pending-sync items, sign-in). Meaning: the service did not answer within the time limit. Placeholders: {service} = AniList or MyAnimeList. Length: short.
auth.cancelled: Where: red alert under the Connect button (popup welcome screen, Settings › Accounts). Meaning: the user closed the AniList/MyAnimeList sign-in window before finishing. Length: short.
auth.denied: Where: red alert under the Connect button (popup welcome screen, Settings › Accounts). Meaning: on the service's authorization page, access for SyncKai was refused. Placeholders: {service} = AniList or MyAnimeList. Length: short.
auth.exchangeFailed.mal: Where: red alert under 'Connect MyAnimeList' (popup, Settings › Accounts). Meaning: MAL refused the final sign-in step. Placeholders: {url} = OAuth redirect URL, e.g. https://abc….chromiumapp.org/. Length: long. Notes: 'App Redirect URL' = MAL's English form-field name, keep as is; keep {url} last with nothing after it (copyable).
auth.failed: Where: red alert under the Connect button (popup welcome screen, Settings › Accounts). Meaning: the browser's sign-in flow failed for another reason. Placeholders: {message} = raw technical browser error, usually English, e.g. 'Authorization page could not be loaded.'. Length: short prefix + message.
auth.finalizeFailed: Where: red alert under 'Connect MyAnimeList' (popup welcome screen, Settings › Accounts). Meaning: the MyAnimeList sign-in could not be completed (the final token step failed unexpectedly). Length: short.
auth.invalidResponse.anilist: Where: red alert under 'Connect AniList' (popup welcome screen, Settings › Accounts). Meaning: AniList's sign-in (OAuth) answer was malformed or lacked the access token. Length: short. Notes: AniList is a product name.
auth.invalidResponse.mal: Where: red alert under 'Connect MyAnimeList' (popup welcome screen, Settings › Accounts). Meaning: MyAnimeList's sign-in (OAuth) answer was malformed or did not match the request. Length: short. Notes: MyAnimeList is a product name.
auth.noResponse.anilist: Where: red alert under 'Connect AniList' (popup welcome screen, Settings › Accounts). Meaning: the sign-in window ended without returning any answer from AniList. Length: short. Notes: AniList is a product name.
auth.noResponse.mal: Where: red alert under 'Connect MyAnimeList' (popup welcome screen, Settings › Accounts). Meaning: the sign-in window ended without returning any answer from MyAnimeList. Length: short. Notes: MyAnimeList is a product name.
auth.notConfigured: Where: red alert under the Connect button (popup, Settings › Accounts); also a MyAnimeList session error. Meaning: this browser build (extension ID) has no registered AniList/MAL client, so sign-in cannot work. Placeholders: {url} = redirect URL to register with the service. Length: long. Notes: keep {url} last; 'Redirect URL' may stay English.
auth.rejected.anilist: Where: red alert under 'Connect AniList' (popup, Settings › Accounts). Meaning: AniList's authorization page rejected the request. 'Client' = the AniList API client (developer app). Placeholders: {url} = expected redirect URL. Length: long. Notes: 'Redirect URL' = AniList's English field name, keep as is; keep {url} last.
auth.rejected.mal: Where: red alert under 'Connect MyAnimeList' (popup, Settings › Accounts). Meaning: MyAnimeList's authorization page rejected the request (app misconfigured). Placeholders: {url} = expected redirect URL. Length: long. Notes: 'App Redirect URL' = MAL's English field name, keep as is; keep {url} last with nothing after it.
auth.saveFailed: Where: red alert under 'Connect AniList' (popup welcome screen, Settings › Accounts). Meaning: sign-in succeeded but the session (access token) could not be stored locally. 'Session' = the sign-in session. Length: short.
backup.error.corrupted: Where: Backup page (full tab, opened from Settings › My data › Import…), red error alert after the user picks a file to import. Meaning: the file looks like a SyncKai backup but required data is missing or invalid. Length: medium, one sentence with final period.
backup.error.invalidJson: Where: Backup page (full tab), red error alert after the user picks a file to import. Meaning: the file can't be parsed as JSON (a file format). Keep 'JSON' as is. Length: short sentence.
backup.error.notBackup: Where: Backup page (full tab), red error alert after the user picks a file to import. Meaning: the file is valid JSON but was not exported by SyncKai. 'SyncKai' is the product name (never translate). Length: short sentence.
backup.error.tooLarge: Where: Backup page (full tab), red error alert when the picked file is too big. Meaning: limit of 5 megabytes; use your locale's unit abbreviation (FR 'Mo', DE 'MB'). Length: short sentence.
backup.error.version: Where: Backup page (full tab), red error alert after picking a file. Meaning: the backup was made by a SyncKai version whose backup format this version can't read. 'SyncKai' untranslated. Length: medium, one sentence.
backup.fileName: Where: file name of the downloaded backup (Export button). Placeholders: {date} = YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. 2026-10-13. Notes: translate only the word 'backup'; keep the 'synckai-' prefix, '.json', lowercase and hyphens; no spaces or characters invalid in file names (/ \ : * ? " < > |). FR 'synckai-sauvegarde-{date}.json'.
common.actionFailed: Where: 'To check' card (popup › Activity), bold title of a red error box (the message is on the next line). Meaning: the user's action (dismissing the card or stopping syncing) failed. Length: short. Notes: title-like noun phrase, no final period.
common.cancel: Where: secondary button of inline confirmations: remove-from-list (menus), comment editor, side panel schedule delay editor, AniList↔MAL bulk alignment, Settings › My data reset, backup import 'replace' warning. Meaning: abort the pending action (never 'Drop' a series). Length: short (~10 chars). Notes: imperative verb.
common.close: Where: button shown in a 'To check' card (popup › Activity) once its result is displayed; also aria-label of the × button of SyncKai toasts overlaid on the streaming site. Meaning: close/dismiss the card or toast. Length: short. Notes: imperative verb.
common.confirm: Where: primary button of a 'To check' card in popup › Activity (applies the chosen AniList entry and episode), of the AniList↔MAL bulk alignment and of the Settings › My data reset. Meaning: confirm/validate. Length: short (~12 chars). Notes: imperative verb; shows 'Syncing…' (common.syncing) while sending.
common.connect: Where: Settings › Accounts, small button on an AniList/MyAnimeList row marked 'Not connected'. Meaning: sign in / link your AniList or MyAnimeList account (opposite of 'Disconnect'). Length: short (~12 chars). Notes: imperative verb; screen readers get common.connectService.
common.connectService: Where: big button on the popup welcome screen (visible) and aria-label of the Settings › Accounts button. Meaning: sign in / link your account. Placeholders: {service} = 'AniList' or 'MyAnimeList' (never translated). Length: short-medium. Notes: imperative; adapt word order freely (DE '{service} verbinden').
common.connecting: Where: replaces 'Connect' / 'Connect {service}' on the button while the AniList/MyAnimeList sign-in window is open. Meaning: account sign-in in progress. Length: short. Notes: ends with the ellipsis character '…'.
common.excludeFailed: Where: popup › Activity: error alert under 'Recent syncs' and error message in a 'To check' card. Meaning: excluding the series from syncing ('Stop syncing') failed. Length: medium, full sentence. Notes: informal tone (FR 'tu', DE 'du'); 'Try again' is an imperative.
common.excluded: Where: small grey chip with a ban icon on series rows (popup › Watching, Continue card) and in popup › Activity › Recent syncs. Meaning: this series is excluded from syncing. Length: short (chip, ~12 chars). Notes: adjective describing the series (FR feminine 'Exclue' for 'série'); tooltip is common.excludedTitle.
common.excludedTitle: Where: tooltip of the 'Excluded' chip (popup › Watching, Activity › Recent syncs); also title of a SyncKai toast on the streaming site when the sync-episode keyboard shortcut is used on an excluded series. Meaning: SyncKai no longer syncs this series. Length: medium. Notes: statement, no final period.
common.ignore: Where: popup › Activity, ghost button on a 'To check' card and on a 'To rate' card. Meaning: dismiss/skip this item without acting (no sync, no rating); it does NOT ignore or exclude the series. Length: short (~10 chars). Notes: imperative verb.
common.open: Where: tooltip of the TV-screen icon link on popup › Watching rows, visible button on side panel › Schedule rows, and button of the new-episode browser notification (Chrome). Meaning: open the series/episode on the streaming platform. Length: short (~8 chars). Notes: imperative; same word as quoted in settings.player.help.
common.reconnect: Where: button in the status bar at the bottom of the popup and of the side panel next to 'Session expired', and in Settings › Accounts. Meaning: sign in again to the AniList/MyAnimeList account whose session expired. Length: short (~12 chars, the footer is tight). Notes: imperative verb.
common.reconnectService: Where: visible label of the welcome-screen button when the session expired; aria-label of the Reconnect buttons (footer, Settings › Accounts). Meaning: sign in again to that account. Placeholders: {service} = 'AniList' or 'MyAnimeList'. Length: short-medium. Notes: imperative; word order free.
common.retry: Where: buttons in error alerts (popup, side panel, Settings), Activity › Pending syncs rows, partial-failure banners, and SyncKai toasts on the streaming site. Meaning: try the failed action again. Length: short (~12 chars). Notes: imperative/infinitive button label.
common.labelValue: Where: generic 'label: value' pattern (history-import tooltips 'AniList: 3 → 12', side panel 'Studio: MAPPA', relation links). Placeholders: {label} = a label or service name; {value} = its value. Length: short. Notes: keep {label} before {value} — the code cuts the string at {value} to build a screen-reader prefix. Use your locale's colon spacing.
common.serviceMessage: Where: sync results in popup, side panel, import page and on-site toasts, joined by ' · ' ('AniList: episode 5 saved · MyAnimeList: …'). Placeholders: {service} = 'AniList'/'MyAnimeList' (rarely another label); {message} = translated fragment, lowercase in EN/FR (e.g. 'episode 5 saved'). Length: short. Notes: separator only; locale colon spacing.
common.sessionExpired: Where: status bar at the bottom of the popup and of the side panel (red icon, greyed account logo), under the service button on the welcome screen, Settings › Accounts row. Meaning: the AniList/MyAnimeList sign-in expired or was rejected; the user must reconnect. Length: short (~18 chars, footer). Notes: state, no final period.
common.stopSync: Where: ghost button with a ban icon in a 'To check' card (popup › Activity). Meaning: exclude this series from syncing (all seasons; can be undone in Settings). Not 'stop the current sync'. Length: short (~16 chars). Notes: imperative; tooltip is review.excludeTitle.
common.stopSyncAria: Where: aria-label (screen readers) of the stop-syncing buttons in 'To check' cards and popup › Activity › Recent syncs. Meaning: exclude this series from syncing. Placeholders: {title} = series title from the streaming site, e.g. 'Frieren'. Length: medium. Notes: imperative.
common.stopSyncSeries: Where: red menu item in a series row's '…' menu (popup › Watching) and tooltip of the ban icon button in popup › Activity › Recent syncs. Meaning: exclude this series from syncing (undo with 'Resume syncing' or in Settings). Length: short-medium (menu ≤ 240 px, ~30 chars). Notes: imperative.
common.syncing: Where: status bar at the bottom of the popup and of the side panel while an episode is being written to AniList / MyAnimeList; busy label of the Confirm button in a 'To check' card (popup › Activity); title of the SyncKai toast on the streaming site while an episode is being sent. Meaning: synchronization in progress. Length: short (~12 chars). Notes: ends with '…'.
compare.analyze: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › AniList ↔ MAL differences (Settings sub-page), primary button shown before any analysis. Meaning: start comparing the user's complete AniList and MyAnimeList lists. Length: short (≤ 16 chars). Notes: imperative verb.
compare.analyzedAt: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › AniList ↔ MAL differences, small line under the summary. Meaning: when the last comparison ran. Placeholders: {relative} = lowercase relative time (time.* keys): 'just now', '5 min ago', '2 h ago', 'yesterday', '3 days ago'. Length: short. Notes: must read naturally with each value.
compare.analyzing: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › AniList ↔ MAL differences, label of the Analyze / Run again button while the comparison runs (with spinner). Meaning: both lists (AniList and MyAnimeList) are being read and compared. Length: short (≤ 26 chars).
compare.breakdown.missingAniList_one: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › AniList ↔ MAL differences, breakdown line like '290 not on MAL · 30 progress · 15 statuses · 9 scores'. Meaning: number of series in the user's MyAnimeList list but absent from their AniList list. Placeholders: {count} = number of series. Length: short. Notes: elliptical; agrees with 'series'.
compare.breakdown.missingAniList_other: Plural form of compare.breakdown.missingAniList_one (same breakdown line, parts joined with ' · '). Placeholders: {count} = number of series. Notes: agrees with 'series' (FR « absentes »).
compare.breakdown.missingMal_one: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › AniList ↔ MAL differences, breakdown line (parts joined with ' · '). Meaning: number of series in the user's AniList list but absent from their MyAnimeList list. Placeholders: {count} = number of series. Length: short. Notes: MAL = MyAnimeList, untranslated.
compare.breakdown.missingMal_other: Plural form of compare.breakdown.missingMal_one (same breakdown line, parts joined with ' · '). Placeholders: {count} = number of series. Notes: agrees with 'series' (FR « absentes »).
compare.breakdown.progress_one: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › AniList ↔ MAL differences, breakdown line (parts joined with ' · '). Meaning: number of series whose progress (episodes watched) differs between AniList and MAL. Placeholders: {count} = number of series. Length: short. Notes: elliptical noun ('{count} progress [differences]').
compare.breakdown.progress_other: Plural form of compare.breakdown.progress_one (same breakdown line). Placeholders: {count} = number of series whose progress differs. Notes: EN 'progress' is uncountable; FR « progressions ».
compare.breakdown.score_one: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › AniList ↔ MAL differences, breakdown line (parts joined with ' · '). Meaning: number of series whose score (the user's own rating) differs between AniList and MAL. Placeholders: {count} = number of series. Length: short. Notes: elliptical noun.
compare.breakdown.score_other: Plural form of compare.breakdown.score_one (same breakdown line). Placeholders: {count} = number of series whose score differs.
compare.breakdown.status_one: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › AniList ↔ MAL differences, breakdown line (parts joined with ' · '). Meaning: number of series whose list status (Watching, Completed, On hold…) differs between AniList and MAL. Placeholders: {count} = number of series. Length: short. Notes: elliptical noun.
compare.breakdown.status_other: Plural form of compare.breakdown.status_one (same breakdown line). Placeholders: {count} = number of series whose list status differs.
compare.bulk.anilist: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › AniList ↔ MAL differences, bulk button above the list (filter 'All'). Meaning: for every listed series, keep the AniList values and write them to MyAnimeList (MAL is changed to match AniList). Length: short (≤ 24 chars; two buttons side by side). Notes: opens a confirmation first.
compare.bulk.empty: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › AniList ↔ MAL differences, grey note (info icon) under a disabled bulk button. Meaning: aligning the listed series on {source} would change nothing. Placeholders: {source} = 'AniList' or 'MyAnimeList' (the service whose values would be kept). Length: medium.
compare.bulk.filtered.anilist: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › AniList ↔ MAL differences, bulk button when a filter (e.g. Progress) is active. Meaning: only for the series of the current filter, keep the AniList values and write them to MyAnimeList. Length: short (≤ 24 chars; two buttons side by side). Notes: opens a confirmation first.
compare.bulk.filtered.mal: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › AniList ↔ MAL differences, bulk button when a filter (e.g. Progress) is active. Meaning: only for the series of the current filter, keep the MyAnimeList values and write them to AniList. Length: short (≤ 24 chars; two buttons side by side). Notes: MAL untranslated.
compare.bulk.mal: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › AniList ↔ MAL differences, bulk button above the list (filter 'All'). Meaning: for every listed series, keep the MyAnimeList values and write them to AniList (AniList is changed to match MAL). Length: short (≤ 24 chars; two buttons side by side). Notes: opens a confirmation first.
compare.bulk.running: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › AniList ↔ MAL differences, status line next to a Stop button, above a progress bar; also the status bar at the bottom of the popup and of the side panel while the alignment runs. Meaning: series are being updated to match the chosen service. Placeholders: {done} = series processed, {total} = series in the batch (e.g. '12 / 40'). Length: short (11 px, truncated).
compare.chip.entry: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › AniList ↔ MAL differences, chip on the row of a series missing on one side. Meaning: its state where it exists. Placeholders: {service} = 'AL' or 'MAL' (fixed abbreviations); {status} = list status, e.g. 'Watching'; {progress} = episodes watched, e.g. 5. Length: short (10 px chip). Notes: 'ep.' = episode.
compare.chip.missingAniList: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › AniList ↔ MAL differences, highlighted chip on a series row. Meaning: this series is in the user's MyAnimeList list but missing from their AniList list. Length: short (≤ 18 chars, 10 px chip). Notes: about one series (FR feminine singular « Absente », agrees with « série »).
compare.chip.missingMal: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › AniList ↔ MAL differences, highlighted chip on a series row. Meaning: this series is in the user's AniList list but missing from their MyAnimeList list. Length: short (≤ 18 chars, 10 px chip). Notes: about one series (FR « Absente »); MAL untranslated.
compare.chip.progress: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › AniList ↔ MAL differences, chip on a series row. Meaning: episodes watched on each service. Placeholders: {al} = AniList progress, {mal} = MyAnimeList progress (e.g. 'Ep. AL 12 · MAL 10'). Length: short (10 px chip). Notes: 'Ep.' = episodes; 'AL'/'MAL' are fixed abbreviations.
compare.chip.score: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › AniList ↔ MAL differences, chip on a series row. Meaning: the user's score on each service, out of 10. Placeholders: {al}, {mal} = score with up to one decimal, locale-formatted (e.g. '8.5'), or '–' if none. Length: short (10 px chip). Notes: 'AL'/'MAL' fixed abbreviations.
compare.chip.status: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › AniList ↔ MAL differences, chip on a series row. Meaning: list status on each service. Placeholders: {al}, {mal} = translated statuses (e.g. 'AL Watching · MAL Completed'). Length: short (10 px chip). Notes: 'AL'/'MAL' are fixed abbreviations of AniList/MyAnimeList.
compare.error.busy: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › AniList ↔ MAL differences, error alert. Meaning: an analysis or an update (copying values from one service to the other, FR « alignement ») is already running; only one at a time. Length: medium.
compare.error.noComparison: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › AniList ↔ MAL differences, error alert or reason after 'Matching interrupted:'. Meaning: the saved analysis result no longer exists; the user must run the analysis again. Length: medium. Notes: imperative; FR « tu ».
compare.error.notConnected: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › AniList ↔ MAL differences, error alert (or reason after 'Matching interrupted:'). Meaning: BOTH AniList and MyAnimeList accounts must be connected to compare the lists. Length: medium. Notes: product names untranslated; FR « tu ».
compare.error.unexpected: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › AniList ↔ MAL differences, error alert. Meaning: unknown internal error while comparing or updating the two lists. Length: medium.
compare.filter.all: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › AniList ↔ MAL differences, first filter chip; code appends a space and the count (e.g. 'All 42'). Meaning: show every difference. Length: very short (≤ 10 chars, 10 px pill). Notes: toggle button.
compare.filter.aria: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › AniList ↔ MAL differences, aria-label of the group of filter chips (screen readers only). Meaning: filter the list of differences by type. Length: short.
compare.filter.empty: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › AniList ↔ MAL differences, muted text when the selected filter matches no series. Length: medium.
compare.filter.missingAniList: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › AniList ↔ MAL differences, filter chip; code appends ' {count}' (e.g. 'Not on AniList 12'). Meaning: show series missing from the AniList list (present on MAL). Length: short (≤ 16 chars, 10 px pill). Notes: refers to several series (FR plural « Absentes »).
compare.filter.missingMal: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › AniList ↔ MAL differences, filter chip; code appends ' {count}' (e.g. 'Not on MAL 290'). Meaning: show series missing from the MyAnimeList list (present on AniList). Length: short (≤ 16 chars, 10 px pill). Notes: several series (FR « Absentes »); MAL untranslated.
compare.filter.progress: Where: (1) Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › AniList ↔ MAL differences, filter chip; code appends ' {count}' (e.g. 'Progress 30'); (2) side panel › Now playing › « Your list » card, label left of the − / « Ep. 6 / 28 » / + stepper. Meaning: progress = episodes watched (series whose progress differs; the progress of this anime). Length: short (≤ 12 chars, 10 px pill). Notes: noun.
compare.filter.score: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › AniList ↔ MAL differences, filter chip; code appends ' {count}' (e.g. 'Score 9'). Meaning: series whose score (the user's rating) differs. Length: short (≤ 12 chars, 10 px pill). Notes: noun.
compare.filter.status: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › AniList ↔ MAL differences, filter chip; code appends ' {count}' (e.g. 'Status 15'). Meaning: series whose list status (Watching, Completed…) differs. Length: short (≤ 12 chars, 10 px pill). Notes: noun.
compare.impact.addWarning: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › AniList ↔ MAL differences, small note in the bulk confirmation box. Meaning: series missing on the target service will be created there with the source's status, progress and score. Placeholders: {target}, {source} = 'AniList' or 'MyAnimeList'. Length: long, wraps (10 px).
compare.impact.created_one: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › AniList ↔ MAL differences, highlighted bullet in the bulk confirmation box. Meaning: number of series that will be newly added to the user's list on {target}. Placeholders: {count} = number of series; {target} = 'AniList' or 'MyAnimeList'. Length: medium. Notes: future tense.
compare.impact.created_other: Plural form of compare.impact.created_one. Placeholders: {count} = number of series; {target} = 'AniList' or 'MyAnimeList'. Notes: future tense; English 'series' is invariable.
compare.impact.progress_one: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › AniList ↔ MAL differences, bullet in the bulk confirmation box, under 'On {target}:'. Meaning: number of series whose progress (episodes watched) will be changed. Placeholders: {count} = number of series. Length: short. Notes: past participle describing the pending change.
compare.impact.progress_other: Plural form of compare.impact.progress_one (EN 'progress values changed'). Placeholders: {count} = number of series whose progress will be changed. Notes: bullet describing a pending change.
compare.impact.question_one: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › AniList ↔ MAL differences, heading of the bulk confirmation box (Cancel / Confirm below). Meaning: copy {source}'s values for {count} series; a bullet list of the changes on {target} follows. Placeholders: {count}; {source}, {target} = 'AniList' or 'MyAnimeList'. Notes: ends with ':' introducing the list.
compare.impact.question_other: Plural form of compare.impact.question_one. Placeholders: {count} = number of series; {source} = service whose values are kept; {target} = service that is modified ('AniList' / 'MyAnimeList'). Notes: ends with ':' introducing the bullet list.
compare.impact.score_one: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › AniList ↔ MAL differences, bullet in the bulk confirmation box, under 'On {target}:'. Meaning: number of series whose score (the user's rating) will be changed. Placeholders: {count} = number of series. Length: short. Notes: past participle describing the pending change.
compare.impact.score_other: Plural form of compare.impact.score_one. Placeholders: {count} = number of series whose score will be changed. Notes: bullet describing a pending change.
compare.impact.status_one: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › AniList ↔ MAL differences, bullet in the bulk confirmation box, under 'On {target}:'. Meaning: number of series whose list status (Watching, Completed…) will be changed. Placeholders: {count} = number of series. Length: short. Notes: past participle describing the pending change.
compare.impact.status_other: Plural form of compare.impact.status_one. Placeholders: {count} = number of series whose list status will be changed. Notes: bullet describing a pending change.
compare.intro: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › AniList ↔ MAL differences (Settings sub-page), intro text before the first analysis. Meaning: compares the user's two complete lists (AniList, MyAnimeList); nothing is written without their confirmation. Length: long, wraps (11 px). Notes: 'one side' = one of the two services; FR « tu ».
compare.job.cancelled: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › AniList ↔ MAL differences, result banner after the user pressed Stop; ' · 12 series matched · 2 skipped' may follow. Meaning: the update (copying values to the other service) was stopped by the user. Length: short.
compare.job.dismiss: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › AniList ↔ MAL differences and history import page, small text button closing a result banner. Meaning: acknowledge and close. Length: very short (≤ 6 chars).
compare.job.done: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › AniList ↔ MAL differences, result banner; ' · 12 series matched · 1 failed' may follow. Meaning: the update job (copying values to the other service) completed. Length: short.
compare.job.progressAria: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › AniList ↔ MAL differences, aria-label of the progress bar of the running update (screen readers only). Meaning: progress of copying values to the other service. Length: short.
compare.job.retryFailed: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › AniList ↔ MAL differences, text button in the result banner. Meaning: retry only the series whose update failed. Length: short (≤ 22 chars).
compare.job.stop: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › AniList ↔ MAL differences (running update) and history import page (reading / import), button. Meaning: stop the running background job. Length: short (≤ 10 chars). Notes: imperative verb.
compare.job.stopped: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › AniList ↔ MAL differences, error banner. Meaning: the update stopped because of an error. Placeholders: {message} = reason sentence, e.g. 'MyAnimeList session expired. Please sign in again.' Length: medium; ' · 3 series matched' may follow.
compare.job.stopping: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › AniList ↔ MAL differences and history import page, label of the Stop button once pressed (the current series finishes first). Meaning: stop in progress. Length: short (≤ 12 chars).
compare.keep.anilist: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › AniList ↔ MAL differences, per-series button ('Keep AniList' / 'Keep MAL' side by side). Meaning: keep AniList's values for this series and write them to MyAnimeList. Length: short (≤ 16 chars). Notes: imperative.
compare.keep.mal: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › AniList ↔ MAL differences, per-series button ('Keep AniList' / 'Keep MAL' side by side). Meaning: keep MyAnimeList's values for this series and write them to AniList. Length: short (≤ 16 chars). Notes: imperative; MAL untranslated.
compare.keepAria: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › AniList ↔ MAL differences, aria-label of a Keep button (screen readers only). Meaning: keep {source}'s values for this series; they get written to {target}. Placeholders: {title} = anime title; {source}, {target} = 'AniList' or 'MyAnimeList'. Length: medium.
compare.keepTitle: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › AniList ↔ MAL differences, tooltip (title) of a Keep button. Meaning: {source}'s status, progress and/or score are copied to {target}. Placeholders: {source}, {target} = 'AniList' or 'MyAnimeList'. Length: medium.
compare.none: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › AniList ↔ MAL differences, green line after an analysis. Meaning: the two lists are identical (no differences found). Length: medium.
compare.notComparableHint: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › AniList ↔ MAL differences, tooltip (title) on the '· N not comparable' count. Meaning: series with no linked entry on the other service cannot be compared. Length: medium. Notes: 'entry' = an anime's page on MyAnimeList (FR « fiche »).
compare.pause.budget: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › AniList ↔ MAL differences and history import page, countdown line during a background job (updated every second). Meaning: waiting until SyncKai may send more background requests to AniList (request quota). Placeholders: {seconds} = integer, e.g. 42. Length: medium. Notes: 's' = seconds.
compare.pause.budgetUnknown: Same line as compare.pause.budget when the end of the wait is unknown. Meaning: waiting until SyncKai may send more background requests to AniList (request quota). Length: medium.
compare.pause.network: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › AniList ↔ MAL differences and history import page, countdown line (updated every second). Meaning: the service can't be reached (network); the job retries when the countdown ends. Placeholders: {service} = 'AniList' or 'MyAnimeList'; {seconds} = integer. Length: medium.
compare.pause.rate-limit: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › AniList ↔ MAL differences and history import page, countdown line (updated every second). Meaning: the service answered 'too many requests'; the job is paused, then resumes. Placeholders: {service} = 'AniList' or 'MyAnimeList'; {seconds} = integer. Length: medium.
compare.pause.resume: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › AniList ↔ MAL differences and history import page, status line of a background job. Meaning: the job is being resumed after it was interrupted (e.g. browser restarted). Length: medium.
compare.pause.server: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › AniList ↔ MAL differences and history import page, countdown line (updated every second). Meaning: the service is overloaded or timing out; the job retries when the countdown ends. Placeholders: {service} = 'AniList' or 'MyAnimeList'; {seconds} = integer. Length: medium.
compare.rerun: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › AniList ↔ MAL differences, small button (retry icon) next to 'Analyzed …'. Meaning: run the comparison analysis again. Length: short (≤ 14 chars).
compare.result.failed_one: Where: result banner of the AniList ↔ MAL update (Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › AniList ↔ MAL differences) and of the history import page; parts joined with ' · ' after 'Matching finished' / 'Import finished'. Meaning: number of series whose update failed. Placeholders: {count}. Length: short.
compare.result.failed_other: Plural form of compare.result.failed_one (same result banner). Placeholders: {count} = number of series whose update failed. Notes: FR uses the noun « échecs ».
compare.result.skipped_one: Where: result banner of the AniList ↔ MAL update (Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › AniList ↔ MAL differences) and of the history import page; parts joined with ' · '. compare.result.skipped_other: Plural form of compare.result.skipped_one (same result banner). Placeholders: {count} = number of series left unchanged. Notes: agrees with 'series' (FR « ignorées »).
compare.result.updated_one: Where: result banner of the AniList ↔ MAL update (Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › AniList ↔ MAL differences) and of the history import page; parts joined with ' · '. Meaning: number of series successfully written on the target service. Placeholders: {count}. Length: short. Notes: also used by the import, so a neutral 'updated' sense works.
compare.result.updated_other: Plural form of compare.result.updated_one (same result banner). Placeholders: {count} = number of series successfully updated. Notes: English 'series' is invariable.
compare.section: Where: Settings (popup & side panel), title of the sub-page under My data (top bar), opened from the 'AniList ↔ MyAnimeList differences' row (settings.compare.title). Meaning: differences between the user's AniList list and their MyAnimeList list. Length: short (≤ 30 chars), the bar wraps on two lines in a narrow panel. Notes: keep '↔'; MAL = MyAnimeList.
compare.showMore: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › AniList ↔ MAL differences, button under the list (30 rows shown at a time). Meaning: show more rows. Placeholders: {count} = rows still hidden, e.g. 120. Length: short.
compare.skip.changed: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › AniList ↔ MAL differences, warning text on a series row and skip reason. Meaning: the entry changed on AniList or MyAnimeList after the analysis; re-run the analysis before matching ('aligning') this series. Length: long, max 2 lines. Notes: FR « tu ».
compare.skip.missingSource: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › AniList ↔ MAL differences, tooltip of a disabled Keep button and skip reason. Meaning: the series isn't in the user's {service} list, so there is nothing to copy; SyncKai never deletes list entries. Placeholders: {service} = 'AniList' or 'MyAnimeList'. Length: medium.
compare.skip.noEquivalent: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › AniList ↔ MAL differences, tooltip of a disabled Keep button and skip reason. Meaning: the anime has no corresponding entry (page) on the other service, so nothing can be written there. Length: medium.
compare.skip.noScore: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › AniList ↔ MAL differences, tooltip of a disabled Keep button and skip reason. Meaning: only the scores differ and {service} has no score; an empty score never erases the other one. Placeholders: {service} = 'AniList' or 'MyAnimeList'. Length: medium.
compare.skip.nothing: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › AniList ↔ MAL differences, tooltip / skip reason. Meaning: the series already has the same values on both services. Length: short. Notes: about one series (FR feminine « Déjà alignée »).
compare.summary.compared_one: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › AniList ↔ MAL differences, summary line '{n} series compared · {n} differences · {n} not comparable'. Meaning: number of series compared across both lists. Placeholders: {count}. Length: short.
compare.summary.compared_other: Plural form of compare.summary.compared_one (same summary line, joined with ' · '). Placeholders: {count} = number of series compared. Notes: English 'series' is invariable.
compare.summary.diffs_one: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › AniList ↔ MAL differences, summary line (parts joined with ' · '). Meaning: number of series that differ in at least one way between AniList and MyAnimeList. Placeholders: {count}. Length: short.
compare.summary.diffs_other: Plural form of compare.summary.diffs_one (same summary line). Placeholders: {count} = number of series that differ (FR « écarts »).
compare.summary.notComparable_one: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › AniList ↔ MAL differences, end of the summary line (' · N not comparable', tooltip compare.notComparableHint). Meaning: number of series that cannot be compared (no linked entry on the other service). Placeholders: {count}. Length: short. Notes: agrees with 'series'.
compare.summary.notComparable_other: Plural form of compare.summary.notComparable_one (same summary line). Placeholders: {count} = number of series that cannot be compared.
content.episodeShort: Where: in-page toast (pill) on the streaming site, text after 'Episode already synced · '. Meaning: identifies the episode. Placeholders: {title} = series title from the site, e.g. 'One Piece'; {number} = episode number, e.g. 1180. Length: short (truncated with …). Notes: lowercase 'episode' mid-line (German capitalizes nouns).
content.shortcut.noPlayback.message: Where: in-page toast bubble on the streaming site, message under the title. Meaning: the 'mark episode as watched' keyboard shortcut was pressed on a page where no episode is playing; open one first. Length: medium (bubble 280 px). Notes: informal imperative (FR tu, DE du); 'the shortcut' = that keyboard shortcut.
content.shortcut.noPlayback.title: Where: in-page toast bubble title on the streaming site. Meaning: shown when the 'mark episode as watched' keyboard shortcut is pressed but no video/episode is playing on the page. Length: short (bold title, 280 px bubble).
content.shortcut.paused.message: Where: in-page toast bubble on the streaming site, message. Meaning: the shortcut did nothing because automatic sync is paused; re-enable 'Auto sync' in SyncKai's Settings, then press it again. Length: medium. Notes: 'Settings' = SyncKai's Settings tab (nav.settings); informal you (FR tu, DE du).
content.shortcut.paused.title: Where: in-page toast bubble title on the streaming site. Meaning: the user paused automatic syncing (Settings › Auto sync), so the 'mark episode as watched' shortcut sent nothing. Length: short. Notes: same wording as the side panel status 'Auto sync paused'.
content.unidentified.message: Where: in-page error toast message on the streaming site; also the detail line of the side panel's live status. Meaning: at the end of the episode, SyncKai could not read the episode info on the web page, so nothing was synced. Length: medium.
content.unidentified.title: Where: in-page error toast title on the streaming site. Meaning: the finished episode could not be identified (title/number not readable on the page); nothing was synced. Length: short.
content.unreachable.full: Where: in-page error bubble on the streaming site, message under 'Rating not saved' / 'Rewatch not saved'. Meaning: the page script could not reach the SyncKai extension background (e.g. after an extension reload). Length: medium. Notes: = content.unreachable.title + '. ' + content.unreachable.message; keep them consistent.
content.unreachable.message: Where: in-page error toast message on the streaming site; also side panel live status detail. Meaning: advice when the page could not reach the SyncKai extension background. Length: short. Notes: informal imperative (FR tu, DE du).
content.unreachable.title: Where: in-page error toast title on the streaming site. Meaning: the page script could not communicate with the SyncKai extension (background service worker), e.g. after an update or reload. Length: short. Notes: SyncKai is a product name.
content.updated.message: Where: in-page warning toast message on the streaming site. Meaning: the extension was updated/reloaded since this page was opened; the page must be reloaded so this episode can be synced. Length: medium. Notes: informal imperative (FR tu, DE du).
content.updated.title: Where: in-page warning toast title on the streaming site. Meaning: the SyncKai extension was updated (or reloaded) after this tab was opened. Length: short. Notes: SyncKai is a product name.
controls.alreadyLast: Where: popup/side panel, detail tooltip of a +1 result ('AniList: …'). Meaning: +1 was refused: the list progress already equals the series' last episode. Length: short. Notes: reason fragment shown after '{service}: '; code lowercases its first letter (not in German); no final period.
controls.nothingToRemove: Where: popup/side panel, detail tooltip of a −1 result ('AniList: …'). Meaning: −1 was refused: progress is already 0, no watched episode to subtract. 'Remove' = decrement the count, NOT remove from list. Length: short. Notes: fragment after '{service}: '; first letter lowercased by code (not German); no period.
crImport.pageTitle: Where: browser tab title (document.title) of the history import page. Meaning: import the user's watch history from a streaming platform. Length: short. Notes: same wording as crImport.title; keep ' · SyncKai' at the end (product name, never translated).
crImport.title: Where: history import page (full tab), main h1 heading. Meaning: import the user's watch history from a streaming platform (Crunchyroll, ADN, Netflix) into AniList/MyAnimeList; action title. Length: short (≤ 30 chars). Notes: same text as the Settings button settings.backup.crImport.
crImport.subtitle: Where: history import page (full tab), muted subtitle under the h1. Meaning: the arrow means 'imported into'. Placeholders: {platform} = Crunchyroll, ADN or Netflix (never translated). Length: medium, one line. Notes: keep the arrow and 'AniList / MyAnimeList'; informal 'your' (FR ton, DE dein).
crImport.platform: Where: history import page (full tab), uppercase section title above the three platform tiles (Crunchyroll, ADN, Netflix); also the screen-reader name of that choice. Meaning: the streaming platform whose watch history will be read. Length: short (one line at 400 px, shown in capitals). Notes: noun phrase.
crImport.loading: Where: history import page (full tab), card with a spinner while the page restores the saved import state (accounts, access, running job), before the platform tiles appear. Meaning: generic 'loading'. Length: short. Notes: keep the ellipsis character '…'.
crImport.steps: Where: history import page (full tab), screen-reader name (aria-label) of the 5-step indicator under the page title (Platform, Reading, Analysis, Preview, Import). Meaning: the steps of the import. Length: short (one word). Notes: never visible.
crImport.step.platform: Where: history import page (full tab), step 1 of the step indicator under the page title, next to a numbered circle. Meaning: choosing the streaming platform whose history is imported. Length: very short (one word, ≤ 12 chars; 5 steps share one line at 576 px). Notes: noun, no verb.
crImport.step.reading: Where: history import page (full tab), step 2 of the step indicator. Meaning: SyncKai reads the watch history in the platform's tab. Length: very short (one word, ≤ 12 chars). Notes: noun (the act of reading), not 'Read' as a button.
crImport.step.analysis: Where: history import page (full tab), step 3 of the step indicator. Meaning: SyncKai finds each season on AniList and compares it with the user's lists. Length: very short (one word, ≤ 12 chars). Notes: same word as in crImport.analyze.running.
crImport.step.preview: Where: history import page (full tab), step 4 of the step indicator. Meaning: the preview of the changes, which the user checks before anything is written. Length: very short (one word, ≤ 12 chars). Notes: same term as 'preview' in crImport.rule.preview.
crImport.step.import: Where: history import page (full tab), step 5 of the step indicator. Meaning: the changes are written to AniList / MyAnimeList. Length: very short (one word, ≤ 12 chars). Notes: noun, same word as in crImport.apply.running.
crImport.tile.ready: Where: history import page (full tab), green line with a check icon under the platform name, in each platform tile (Crunchyroll, ADN, Netflix). Meaning: a tab of that platform is open and can be read. Length: short (tile ≈ 150 px wide, may wrap on two lines). Notes: fragment, no platform name (it is the tile's title).
crImport.tile.none: Where: history import page (full tab), grey line with a tab icon in a platform tile. Meaning: no tab of that platform is open in the browser. Length: short (may wrap on two lines). Notes: fragment, no final period.
crImport.tile.access: Where: history import page (full tab), yellow line with an alert icon in a platform tile. Meaning: SyncKai needs the user's permission to access that site (Netflix is optional; Crunchyroll / ADN access can be removed on Firefox); the 'Allow access' button appears when the tile is chosen. Length: short (may wrap on two lines). Notes: fragment; not an error.
crImport.tile.waiting: Where: history import page (full tab), purple line with a spinner in the chosen platform tile, after 'Open {platform}' was clicked. Meaning: the platform's tab has been opened, SyncKai waits for it to be ready (the user may need to sign in). Length: short. Notes: keep the ellipsis character '…'.
crImport.netflix.heading: Where: history import page (full tab), bold title of the Netflix reading card, next to the Netflix logo and the 'Stop' button; the three reading steps are listed under it. Meaning: SyncKai is reading the user's Netflix watch history. Length: short (one line at 576 px).
crImport.netflix.rowsDone: Where: history import page (full tab), Netflix reading card, first of three steps, shown with a green check once that step is done. Meaning: the Netflix viewing activity page has been fully loaded. Placeholders: {rows} = number of history rows loaded, e.g. 214. Length: medium. Notes: same wording as crImport.netflix.rows, without the ellipsis (finished); no plural variants.
crImport.netflix.titlesNext: Where: history import page (full tab), Netflix reading card, second of three steps, greyed while not started yet. Meaning: SyncKai will look for the history's titles on AniList to keep only the anime. Length: medium. Notes: same wording as crImport.netflix.titles, without the counts; no ellipsis.
crImport.netflix.showsNext: Where: history import page (full tab), Netflix reading card, third of three steps, greyed while not started yet. Meaning: SyncKai will read the user's progress on Netflix, only for the series kept as anime. Length: medium. Notes: same wording as crImport.netflix.shows, without the counts; no ellipsis.
crImport.intro: Where: history import page (full tab), intro paragraph of the first step. Meaning: SyncKai reads the watch history inside the user's open {platform} browser tab, matches each season to an AniList entry, then shows a preview before writing to any list. Placeholders: {platform} = Crunchyroll, ADN or Netflix. Length: long, wraps.
crImport.rule.never: Where: history import page (full tab), bullet in the rules list. Meaning: the import never lowers progress; series the user marked Completed or is Rewatching on AniList/MyAnimeList are never modified. Length: long, wraps. Notes: 'Never backwards' is a short slogan before the colon.
crImport.rule.preview: Where: history import page (full tab), bullet in the rules list. Meaning: all changes are shown in a preview before importing; an uncertain season match is not written but listed 'To check' for the user to confirm. Length: medium. Notes: 'Preview' is a noun; 'review' = that 'To check' list (FR vérification).
crImport.rule.privacy: Where: history import page (full tab), bullet in the rules list. Meaning: privacy promise: the watch history is processed locally in the browser and only sent to AniList / MyAnimeList (no other server). Length: medium-long.
crImport.connect.none: Where: history import page (full tab), muted status line above the 'Open {platform}' button. Meaning: no browser tab of that streaming site is open. Placeholders: {platform} = Crunchyroll, ADN or Netflix. Length: short.
crImport.connect.open: Where: history import page (full tab), primary pill button (one line). Meaning: opens the platform's website in a new background browser tab. Placeholders: {platform} = Crunchyroll, ADN or Netflix. Length: short (≤ 25 chars). Notes: imperative verb.
crImport.connect.openFailed: Where: history import page (full tab), red error box. Meaning: SyncKai could not open the site; the user must open it in a tab manually. Placeholders: {platform} = Crunchyroll/ADN/Netflix; {site} = address, e.g. www.crunchyroll.com, animationdigitalnetwork.com, netflix.com/viewingactivity (never translated). Length: medium.
crImport.connect.waiting: Where: history import page (full tab), status line with spinner after clicking 'Open {platform}'. Meaning: waiting until the newly opened platform tab is detected; the user may have to sign in to the platform in that tab. Placeholders: {platform} = Crunchyroll, ADN or Netflix. Length: medium. Notes: keep '…'.
crImport.connect.found: Where: history import page (full tab), green status line with check icon, one line (cut off with '…'). Meaning: a tab of the platform is open and ready to be read. Placeholders: {platform} = Crunchyroll, ADN or Netflix. Length: short. Notes: variant of crImport.connect.foundTitled when the tab has no title.
crImport.connect.foundTitled: Where: history import page (full tab), green status line with check icon, one line (cut off with '…'). Meaning: as crImport.connect.found, plus the tab's title. Placeholders: {platform} = Crunchyroll/ADN/Netflix; {title} = the tab's page title set by the site, e.g. 'Netflix'. Length: short prefix. Notes: keep {title} last (long titles get cut).
crImport.connect.read: Where: history import page (full tab), primary pill button once the platform tab is found. Meaning: start reading the watch history in that tab (nothing is written yet). Length: short (≤ 25 chars). Notes: imperative; error messages saying 'read again' refer to this button.
crImport.connect.reload: Where: history import page (full tab), link-style action button inside a red error box. Meaning: reloads the platform's browser tab (its page did not respond). Length: short (≤ 20 chars). Notes: imperative.
crImport.connect.showTab: Where: history import page (full tab), link-style action button inside a red error box. Meaning: switches to the platform's browser tab (brings it to the front) so the user can fix the problem there. Length: short (≤ 20 chars). Notes: imperative.
crImport.connect.access: Where: history import page (full tab), bold amber warning above the 'Allow access' button. Meaning: the browser permission to access the platform's site was removed (e.g. on Firefox); granting it lets SyncKai read the history. Placeholders: {platform} = Crunchyroll or ADN. Length: medium-long. Notes: 'it' = SyncKai.
crImport.connect.netflixAccess: Where: history import page (full tab), bold amber warning above 'Allow access' (Netflix). Meaning: Netflix support is optional and needs the browser permission for netflix.com; granting it also enables live sync while watching Netflix (can be disabled in Settings). Length: long. Notes: 'Settings' = nav.settings; keep netflix.com.
crImport.connect.allow: Where: history import page (full tab), primary pill button. Meaning: opens the browser's permission prompt to grant SyncKai access to the platform's website. Length: short (≤ 25 chars). Notes: imperative.
crImport.read.starting: Where: history import page (full tab), progress line with spinner, start of reading. Meaning: SyncKai is connecting to the platform tab before the first history page arrives. Placeholders: {platform} = Crunchyroll, ADN or Netflix. Length: short. Notes: keep '…'.
crImport.read.progress: Where: history import page (full tab), progress line with spinner while reading (Crunchyroll, ADN). Meaning: history pages fetched so far and watched episodes found in them. Placeholders: {pages}, {items} = running counts, e.g. 3 and 287. Length: medium. Notes: no plural variants: phrase it to work with any number.
crImport.read.lookups: Where: history import page (full tab), progress line with spinner + progress bar (Crunchyroll only). Meaning: SyncKai checks each season's episode list to find the episode's position within its season. Placeholders: {done} / {total} = seasons checked / to check, e.g. 4 / 37. Length: medium. Notes: no plural variants.
crImport.read.progressAria: Where: history import page (full tab), aria-label (screen readers only) of the progress bar while the platform history is read (also used for the Netflix steps). Length: short. Notes: noun phrase.
crImport.read.keepTab: Where: history import page (full tab), small hint under the reading progress (Crunchyroll, ADN). Meaning: closing or reloading the platform tab interrupts the reading. Placeholders: {platform} = Crunchyroll or ADN. Length: medium. Notes: imperative, informal you (FR tu, DE du).
crImport.read.partial: Where: history import page (full tab), green notice at the top after reading, and amber line in the preview. Meaning: the history was longer than the reading limit, so only its most recent part was read. Length: medium.
crImport.read.error.logged-out: Where: history import page (full tab), red error box (Crunchyroll). Meaning: the user isn't signed in to the platform in that browser tab: sign in there, then click 'Read my history' again. Placeholders: {platform} = Crunchyroll. Length: medium. Notes: 'that tab' = the platform tab; imperative.
crImport.read.error.adnLoggedOut: Where: history import page (full tab), red error box (ADN). Meaning: no ADN sign-in found: open ADN in that tab and sign in (if already signed in, reload the ADN page), then click 'Read my history' again. Length: long. Notes: ADN is a platform name, never translated; imperative.
crImport.read.error.netflixLoggedOut: Where: history import page (full tab), red error box (Netflix). Meaning: Netflix shows its sign-in or profile picker: sign in, pick the profile, reopen Netflix's Viewing activity page, then click 'Read my history' again. Length: long. Notes: use Netflix's own localized name for its 'Viewing activity' page.
crImport.read.error.unavailable: Where: history import page (full tab), red error box. Meaning: the platform changed its website/API so the history import no longer works; live sync while watching episodes is not affected. Placeholders: {platform} = Crunchyroll, ADN or Netflix.
