page.added.PLANNING: Where: same feedback line, after 'Add to Plan to watch'. Meaning: the series was added to your list with status Plan to watch. Length: short. Notes: implied subject = the series; status name as page.status.PLANNING.
page.airing.CANCELLED: Where: info line under the title ('On this page' card, side panel › Now playing), e.g. 'Season 2 · 2023 · 12 eps. · Cancelled'. Meaning: AniList airing status: the anime was cancelled. Length: short. Notes: describes the anime (FR feminine 'Annulée' for 'série').
page.airing.FINISHED: Where: same info line. Meaning: the anime has finished airing (all episodes released). NOT the user's 'Completed' list status. Length: short. Notes: describes the anime (FR 'Terminée').
page.airing.HIATUS: Where: same info line. Meaning: airing is paused by the producers (hiatus). NOT the user's 'On hold' list status. Length: short.
page.airing.NOT_YET_RELEASED: Where: same info line. Meaning: the anime is announced but hasn't started airing yet. Length: short.
page.airing.RELEASING: Where: same info line. Meaning: the anime is currently airing (new episodes being released). Length: short.
page.alreadyInList: Where: info feedback line in 'On this page'/side panel after an Add; also per-service detail in tooltips ('AniList: already in your list', first letter lowercased except in German). Meaning: the series was already in your list, nothing changed. Length: short. Notes: no final period.
page.episodes_one: Where: info line under the title ('On this page' card, side panel › Now playing), e.g. '2023 · 1 ep. · Finished'. Meaning: total episode count of the anime. Placeholders: {count} = 1. Length: short. Notes: abbreviation expected.
page.episodes_other: Plural form of page.episodes_one, e.g. '12 eps.'. Placeholders: {count} = episode count. Notes: abbreviation expected; only _one/_other exist, so this form serves every count not in 'one'.
page.listsAria: Where: aria-label (screen readers) of the list giving the series' status in each connected AniList/MyAnimeList list ('On this page' card, side panel › Now playing). Length: medium.
page.loading: Where: aria-label (screen readers) of the loading placeholder of the 'On this page' card (popup). Meaning: the AniList entry is loading. Placeholders: {title} = series title read from the streaming page, e.g. 'Frieren'. Length: medium.
page.manualNotSaved: Where: amber warning above the season dropdown ('On this page' card, side panel › Now playing). Meaning: the user picked a season that doesn't contain the current episode: it is shown but not saved as the match. Length: long (wraps). Notes: 'sync' = SyncKai's automatic syncing (noun).
page.minusOneAria: Where: aria-label and tooltip of the '−' button ('On this page' card, side panel › Now playing, series rows of popup › Watching). Meaning: lower watched progress by one episode. Placeholders: {title} = series or AniList entry title. Length: medium.
page.notFound: Where: error alert with Retry in the 'On this page' card (popup) and message in side panel › Now playing. Meaning: no AniList entry was found for the series open in the tab. Placeholders: {title} = series title from the streaming site. Length: medium. Notes: full sentence with final period.
page.notTracked: Where: neutral grey message in the 'On this page' card and side panel › Now playing on Netflix/Disney+. Meaning: this title isn't an anime known to AniList, so SyncKai ignores it. Placeholders: {platform} = 'Netflix' or 'Disney+'. Length: long (wraps). Notes: 'track' = follow viewing progress.
page.platformOff: Where: same places as page.notTracked. Meaning: the user turned this optional platform off, so nothing is tracked. Placeholders: {platform} = 'Netflix', 'Disney+' or 'Prime Video'. Length: long (wraps). Notes: 'Settings › Platforms' must match the translated nav.settings and settings.cat.platforms; keep '›'. Changed 2026-10-17 (path was Settings › Playback & sync).
page.notInList: Where: per-service status line (AniList/MAL icon + text) in the 'On this page' card and side panel › Now playing. Meaning: the series isn't in this service's list. Length: short (truncated). Notes: no final period.
page.openOn: Where: visible menu item in a series row's '…' menu (popup › Watching); aria-label of the AniList/MAL link chips in the 'On this page' card header. Meaning: open the anime's page on AniList/MyAnimeList (new tab). Placeholders: {service} = 'AniList' or 'MyAnimeList'. Length: medium (menu ≤ 240 px).
page.seasonOption: Where: option text of the season dropdown ('On this page' card, side panel › Now playing). Placeholders: {season} = season number, e.g. 2; {title} = AniList entry title with year, e.g. 'Mushoku Tensei II (2023)'. Length: medium. Notes: '—' separates season and title.
page.seasonOptionPart: Where: same dropdown, for a season split into several AniList entries. Placeholders: {season} = season number, e.g. 2; {part} = part number, e.g. 1; {title} = entry title with year. Length: medium. Notes: 'part' lowercase in EN/FR (follows '·').
page.seasonPicker: Where: visible label just before the season dropdown ('On this page' card, side panel › Now playing). Meaning: 'Season' (noun): which season of the series the card shows. Length: very short.
page.seasonPickerAria: Where: aria-label (screen readers) of the season dropdown. Meaning: choose which season's AniList entry is shown. Length: medium.
page.seasonSlot: Where: start of the info line under the title ('On this page' card, side panel › Now playing), e.g. 'Season 2 · 2023 · 12 eps.'. Placeholders: {season} = season number, e.g. 2. Length: short.
page.seasonSlotPart: Where: same info line, for a season split across AniList entries. Placeholders: {season} = season number; {part} = this part, e.g. 1; {parts} = number of parts, e.g. 2. Length: short. Notes: 'part' lowercase in EN/FR (follows '·').
page.status.COMPLETED: Where: list-status chip and per-service lines ('Completed · Ep. 12 / 12') in the 'On this page' card and side panel; AniList↔MAL differences chips (popup › Activity). Meaning: user list status Completed = the user finished the series (not 'finished airing'). Length: short (chip, ~14 chars). Notes: AniList/MAL community term.
page.status.CURRENT: Where: same as page.status.COMPLETED. Meaning: user list status Watching (series in progress; AniList/MAL 'Watching'). Length: short (chip). Notes: community term; in EN/FR/DE it equals the popup tab name (nav.watching); reused in page.addCurrent / page.added.CURRENT.
page.status.DROPPED: Where: same as page.status.COMPLETED. Meaning: user list status Dropped (the user abandoned the series). Length: short (chip). Notes: AniList/MAL community term.
page.status.PAUSED: Where: same as page.status.COMPLETED. Meaning: user list status Paused (AniList) / On-Hold (MAL). Length: short (chip). Notes: community term; not the airing 'hiatus'.
page.status.PLANNING: Where: same as page.status.COMPLETED. Meaning: user list status Planning (AniList) / Plan to Watch (MAL). Length: short (chip). Notes: community term; reused in page.addPlanning / page.added.PLANNING.
page.status.REPEATING: Where: same as page.status.COMPLETED. Meaning: user list status Rewatching (AniList 'Rewatching', API 'REPEATING'; MAL 're-watching'). Length: short (chip). Notes: community term.
page.title: Where: popup › Watching, small label at the top of the card showing the AniList entry of the series open in the current tab; also the card's aria-label. Meaning: 'On this page' = the page of the active browser tab. Length: short.
page.unavailable: Where: per-service status line in the 'On this page' card and side panel › Now playing. Meaning: the anime has no equivalent entry on that service (e.g. no MyAnimeList page for the AniList entry). Length: short-medium (truncated). Notes: no final period.
page.uncertain: Where: amber warning above the season dropdown ('On this page' card, side panel › Now playing). Meaning: SyncKai guessed the season; check it (and change it if needed) in the dropdown below. Length: medium. Notes: informal imperative.
page.currentStatus: Where: popup › 'On this page' card, '…' menu: small grey mention at the end of the status item (Put on hold / Drop / Mark as completed) that matches the series' current list status; that item is greyed out. Meaning: this is already the series' status. Length: short (≤ 16 chars).
page.details: Where: popup › 'On this page' card, foldable button under the progress row (chevron after it). Meaning: shows the season dropdown, the user's star rating and the comment of the anime shown. Length: medium (one line in a 350 px card). Notes: the three nouns are a list of what the section holds.
page.seasonOnAniList: Where: popup › 'On this page' card › Details: small uppercase title above the season dropdown. Meaning: the AniList entry (season) matched to the series of the page; the dropdown lets the user pick another one. Length: short.
page.seasonHelp: Where: popup › 'On this page' card › Details, grey help under the season dropdown, on an episode page only. Meaning: picking another season saves it as the match, so the next episodes of this series sync to that AniList entry. Length: medium (wraps on two lines).
page.yourRating: Where: popup › 'On this page' card › Details: small uppercase title above the 10 stars. Meaning: the user's own score (out of 10, half stars) for the anime shown. Length: short.
panel.checking: Where: side panel, centered status with spinner when the panel opens. Meaning: the panel checks what the active browser tab shows (supported streaming page or not). Length: medium.
panel.live.autoSyncOff: Where: side panel › Now playing › live progress block, status line. Meaning: automatic sync is turned off in Settings, so this episode won't be sent automatically. Length: short (≤ 30 chars, truncated). Notes: not the video being paused (see panel.live.paused).
panel.live.creditsAt: Where: side panel › Now playing › « You're watching » card, under the progress bar on the right, after a small yellow tick (the same yellow marker as on the bar). Meaning: the end credits of the episode start at this position, the moment SyncKai saves the episode. Placeholders: {time} = position in the episode, e.g. '21:32' (not a clock time). Length: short (≤ 24 chars, wraps under the playback time if needed). Notes: 'credits' = end credits (FR « générique »); same credits word as settings.trigger.credits.
panel.live.creditsUnknown: Where: same place as panel.live.creditsAt (under the progress bar, on the right, after the yellow tick). Meaning: the platform did not give the start of the end credits, so SyncKai syncs once this share of the episode has been played (the yellow marker shows that point). Placeholders: {percent} = integer, e.g. 85. Length: short (≤ 36 chars, wraps under the playback time if needed). Notes: keep ' · '; same credits word as settings.trigger.credits, same sync word as panel.live.pointRatio; use the locale's percent format (FR '85 %').
panel.live.countdownCredits: Where: side panel › Now playing › « You're watching » card, grey line under the progress bar, updated every second while the episode plays. Meaning: time left before SyncKai saves the episode to the user's lists, which happens at the start of the end credits. Placeholders: {time} = remaining time, e.g. '8 min 40', '2 min', '45 s' (panel.live.minutes*/seconds). Length: one line at 360 px (≤ 48 chars), may wrap. Notes: keep ' · '; 'Sync' = noun; same credits wording as settings.trigger.credits.
panel.live.countdownRatio: Where: same grey line as panel.live.countdownCredits, when the platform does not give the end credits. Meaning: time left before SyncKai saves the episode, which happens once this share of the episode has been played. Placeholders: {time} = remaining time, e.g. '8 min 17'; {percent} = integer, e.g. 85. Length: one line at 360 px (≤ 48 chars), may wrap. Notes: keep ' · '; 'Sync' = noun; use the locale's percent format (FR '85 %').
panel.live.error: Where: side panel › Now playing › live progress block, red status line; the error message is shown below. Meaning: saving the episode to AniList/MyAnimeList failed. Length: short (≤ 30 chars).
panel.live.excluded: Where: side panel › Now playing › live progress block, status line. Meaning: the user excluded this series from sync (Settings › Excluded series), so nothing is sent. Length: short (≤ 30 chars).
panel.live.minutes: Where: side panel › Now playing, value inserted into panel.live.countdownCredits / countdownRatio ('Sync in {time} · …'). Meaning: whole minutes left. Placeholders: {min} = integer, e.g. 2. Length: very short. Notes: unit abbreviation.
panel.live.minutesSeconds: Where: side panel › Now playing, value inserted into panel.live.countdownCredits / countdownRatio ('Sync in {time} · …'). Meaning: minutes and seconds left, e.g. '2 min 05'. Placeholders: {min} = minutes; {sec} = two-digit seconds ('05'). Length: very short. Notes: the seconds unit is omitted in EN/FR/DE.
panel.live.noVideo: Where: side panel › Now playing › live progress block, status line. Meaning: no video player was found on this episode page, so playback can't be followed. Length: short (≤ 30 chars).
panel.live.paused: Where: side panel › Now playing › live progress block, status line. Meaning: the video is paused on the streaming site. Length: short. Notes: video state, not sync (compare panel.live.autoSyncOff).
panel.live.playback: Where: side panel › Now playing, aria-label of the playback progress bar (screen readers only). Meaning: current position in the episode. Length: short.
panel.live.pointCredits: Where: side panel › Now playing › « You're watching » card, grey line under « Paused » (what the sync waits for). Meaning: the episode will be synced when the end credits start. Length: short (≤ 26 chars). Notes: 'credits' = end credits (FR « générique »).
panel.live.pointPassed: Where: side panel › Now playing › live progress block, status line. Meaning: the playback position is already past the sync point (end credits or % threshold). Length: short (≤ 30 chars).
panel.live.pointRatio: Where: side panel › Now playing › « You're watching » card, grey line under « Paused » when the end credits are unknown. Meaning: the episode is synced once this share of it has been played. Placeholders: {percent} = integer, e.g. 85. Length: short. Notes: use the locale's percent format (FR '85 %').
panel.live.position: Where: side panel › Now playing, aria-valuetext of the playback progress bar (screen readers only). Placeholders: {position} = current position, e.g. '12:34'; {duration} = episode length, e.g. '23:40'. Length: short.
panel.live.review: Where: side panel › Now playing › live progress block, warning status line. Meaning: SyncKai isn't sure which AniList entry this is; the user must pick it in the popup's 'To check' section. Length: short. Notes: use the same wording as inline.toCheck.
panel.live.reviewHint: Where: side panel › Now playing › live progress block, detail line under 'To check'. Meaning: click SyncKai's toolbar icon (opens the popup) to choose the right anime entry. Length: medium, wraps. Notes: 'entry' = AniList/MyAnimeList page of an anime (FR « fiche »); FR « tu ».
panel.live.seconds: Where: side panel › Now playing, value inserted into panel.live.countdownCredits / countdownRatio ('Sync in {time} · …'). Meaning: seconds left (under a minute). Placeholders: {sec} = integer, e.g. 45. Length: very short. Notes: unit abbreviation.
panel.live.synced: Where: side panel › Now playing › « You're watching » card, green status line after a check icon. Meaning: the episode has been saved to the user's lists. Length: short. Notes: no ' ✓' in the text (the icon shows it).
panel.live.syncing: Where: side panel › Now playing › live progress block, status line. Meaning: the episode is being saved to the user's AniList/MyAnimeList lists right now. Length: short.
panel.live.unreachable: Where: side panel › Now playing, hint (in the live block, or under 'Open a series or an episode…'). Meaning: the panel can't talk to the streaming tab (e.g. after an extension update); reloading that browser tab fixes it. Length: medium, wraps. Notes: imperative; FR « tu ».
panel.live.waiting: Where: side panel › Now playing › live progress block, status line. Meaning: the streaming site's video player isn't ready yet (duration unknown). Length: short (≤ 30 chars).
panel.nowPlaying.aria: Where: side panel › Now playing, aria-label of the whole anime card (screen readers only). Meaning: the AniList entry (page) of the series open in the tab. Length: short. Notes: 'entry' = FR « fiche ».
panel.nowPlaying.connectHint: Where: side panel › Now playing › « Your list » card, small text. Meaning: no account is connected; accounts are connected in the extension popup. Length: medium, wraps. Notes: AniList, MyAnimeList untranslated; FR « tu ».
panel.nowPlaying.detailsError: Where: side panel › Now playing, error alert with a Retry button. Meaning: the extra AniList details (synopsis, relations, banner…) failed to load. Notes: followed by the error sentence (after a space; none in Japanese and Chinese), e.g. 'AniList is unreachable. Check your connection.'; keep the final period. Length: medium.
panel.nowPlaying.detecting: Where: side panel › Now playing, centered status with spinner. Meaning: the panel is reading the streaming page to identify the series or episode. Length: short.
panel.nowPlaying.discussion: Where: side panel › Now playing, section heading (shown UPPERCASE) above links to Reddit, the MAL forum and AniList. Meaning: discussion threads about the episode or series. Length: short (≤ 20 chars).
panel.nowPlaying.episode: Where: side panel › Now playing, right of the « You're watching » heading (bold). Meaning: the episode open in the tab (numbered as on the AniList entry) out of the entry's total episodes. Placeholders: {episode} = e.g. 5; {total} = e.g. 12. Length: short (≤ 16 chars).
panel.nowPlaying.episodeNoTotal: Same place as panel.nowPlaying.episode, when the total number of episodes is unknown (e.g. still airing). Placeholders: {episode} = number of the episode open in the tab, e.g. 1156. Length: short.
panel.nowPlaying.genres: Where: side panel › Now playing, aria-label of the list of genre chips (screen readers only; genre names come from AniList in English). Length: short.
panel.nowPlaying.list: Where: side panel › Now playing, heading of the card with the user's list status (shown UPPERCASE, followed by the status chip, e.g. « Watching »), the episode stepper and one line per AniList / MyAnimeList account; also the card's aria-label. Meaning: the user's own tracking list on AniList / MyAnimeList for this anime. Length: short (≤ 14 chars). Notes: same 'your list' wording as page.notInList; FR « Ta liste » (tu).
panel.nowPlaying.loading: Where: side panel › Now playing, aria-label of the loading skeleton (screen readers only). Meaning: the anime's AniList entry is loading. Length: medium. Notes: 'entry' = FR « fiche ».
panel.nowPlaying.malForum: Where: side panel › Now playing › Discussions, chip link. Meaning: opens the MyAnimeList forum (this episode's discussion, else the series forum). Length: short (≤ 16 chars). Notes: MAL = MyAnimeList, untranslated.
panel.nowPlaying.newTab: Where: side panel › Now playing, aria-label of external links (screen readers only). Meaning: the link opens in a new browser tab. Placeholders: {label} = link text, e.g. 'Episode discussion', 'MAL forum', 'Studio: MAPPA'. Length: medium.
panel.nowPlaying.noPage: Where: side panel › Now playing, centered status text. Meaning: the tab is on a supported streaming site but not on a series or episode page; opening one shows its AniList entry here. Length: medium, wraps (≤ 280 px). Notes: 'entry' = FR « fiche »; FR « tu ».
panel.nowPlaying.notFoundHint: Where: side panel › Now playing, hint under the 'no matching entry' message, after a decorative Japanese label 'ヒント'. Meaning: finish the episode; SyncKai will then ask the user to pick the entry in the popup's 'To check' section. Length: long, wraps. Notes: “To check” must match inline.toCheck.
panel.nowPlaying.ratingNotes: Where: side panel › Now playing, title of a foldable section (bold, chevron on the right) holding the 10-star rating and the comment of the anime. Meaning: the user's own score and comment (AniList notes / MyAnimeList comments) for this anime. Length: one line at 320 px (≤ 28 chars). Notes: same nouns as page.yourRating (score) and notes.title (comment).
panel.nowPlaying.readLess: Where: side panel › Now playing › Synopsis, text toggle button (expanded state). Meaning: collapse the long synopsis. Length: short (≤ 14 chars).
panel.nowPlaying.readMore: Where: side panel › Now playing › Synopsis, text toggle button. Meaning: expand the synopsis, cut after 5 lines. Length: short (≤ 14 chars).
panel.nowPlaying.reddit: Where: side panel › Now playing › Discussions, chip link (episode pages only). Meaning: opens a Reddit r/anime search for this episode's discussion thread. Length: short (≤ 20 chars). Notes: noun phrase.
panel.nowPlaying.refresh: Where: side panel › Now playing, tooltip and aria-label of an icon-only button on the banner. Meaning: re-read the streaming page and reload the AniList entry. Length: short. Notes: 'entry' = AniList page of the anime (FR « fiche »).
panel.nowPlaying.relation.PARENT: Where: side panel › Now playing › 'Sequels and related', small UPPERCASE label on a related entry, followed by ' · TV'. Meaning: AniList relation 'Parent': the main story that this anime is a side story or spin-off of. Length: short (≤ 18 chars).
panel.nowPlaying.relation.PREQUEL: Where: side panel › Now playing › 'Sequels and related', small UPPERCASE label on a related entry, followed by ' · TV'. Meaning: AniList relation 'Prequel': the entry that comes before this one in the story. Length: short (≤ 18 chars).
panel.nowPlaying.relation.SEQUEL: Where: side panel › Now playing › 'Sequels and related', small UPPERCASE label on a related entry, followed by ' · TV'. Meaning: AniList relation 'Sequel': the entry that continues this one (next season, film…). Length: short (≤ 18 chars).
panel.nowPlaying.relation.SIDE_STORY: Where: side panel › Now playing › 'Sequels and related', small UPPERCASE label on a related entry, followed by ' · TV'. Meaning: AniList relation 'Side story': a story set alongside this one. Length: short (≤ 18 chars).
panel.nowPlaying.relation.SPIN_OFF: Where: side panel › Now playing › 'Sequels and related', small UPPERCASE label on a related entry, followed by ' · TV'. Meaning: AniList relation 'Spin-off': a separate work derived from this one. Length: short (≤ 18 chars).
panel.nowPlaying.relations: Where: side panel › Now playing, section heading (shown UPPERCASE). Meaning: AniList entries related to this anime: prequels, sequels, parent story, side stories, spin-offs. Length: short (≤ 26 chars).
panel.nowPlaying.score: Where: side panel › Now playing, tooltip and aria-label of the star rating (visible text is '86 %'). Meaning: average score given by AniList users to this anime. Placeholders: {score} = integer 0–100, e.g. 86. Length: medium. Notes: use the locale's percent format.
panel.nowPlaying.season.FALL: Where: side panel › Now playing, facts row. Meaning: autumn, as an anime airing season (AniList FALL), with its year (e.g. 'Fall 2024'). Placeholders: {year} = the airing year, e.g. 2024. Put the year where your language writes it ('2024年秋' in Japanese and Chinese, '2024년 가을' in Korean). Length: short. Notes: season name, not the verb.
panel.nowPlaying.season.SPRING: Where: side panel › Now playing, facts row. Meaning: spring, as an anime airing season (AniList SPRING), with its year (e.g. 'Spring 2025'). Placeholders: {year} = the airing year, e.g. 2024. Put the year where your language writes it ('2024年秋' in Japanese and Chinese, '2024년 가을' in Korean). Length: short. Notes: season name.
panel.nowPlaying.season.SUMMER: Where: side panel › Now playing, facts row. Meaning: summer, as an anime airing season (AniList SUMMER), with its year (e.g. 'Summer 2025'). Placeholders: {year} = the airing year, e.g. 2024. Put the year where your language writes it ('2024年秋' in Japanese and Chinese, '2024년 가을' in Korean). Length: short. Notes: season name.
panel.nowPlaying.season.WINTER: Where: side panel › Now playing, facts row. Meaning: winter, as an anime airing season (AniList WINTER), with its year (e.g. 'Winter 2026'). Placeholders: {year} = the airing year, e.g. 2024. Put the year where your language writes it ('2024年秋' in Japanese and Chinese, '2024년 가을' in Korean). Length: short. Notes: season name.
panel.nowPlaying.studio: Where: side panel › Now playing, tooltip on the studio name, and label in its aria-label 'Studio: MAPPA'. Meaning: animation studio that produced the anime. Length: short.
panel.nowPlaying.synopsis: Where: side panel › Now playing, section heading (shown UPPERCASE) above the AniList description. Meaning: plot summary. Length: short.
panel.nowPlaying.watch: Where: side panel › Now playing › 'Sequels and related', small button with a platform logo next to a related entry. Meaning: open that related anime on the streaming platform (new tab). Length: very short (≤ 10 chars). Notes: imperative verb.
panel.nowPlaying.watchOn: Where: side panel › Now playing › 'Sequels and related', tooltip (title) of the Watch button. Meaning: watch the related anime on that platform. Placeholders: {platform} = Crunchyroll, ADN, Netflix or Disney+. Length: short.
panel.nowPlaying.watchAria: Where: side panel › Now playing › 'Sequels and related', aria-label of the Watch button (screen readers only). Placeholders: {title} = related anime title; {platform} = Crunchyroll, ADN, Netflix or Disney+. Notes: '(new tab)' = opens in a new browser tab. Length: medium.
panel.nowPlaying.watching: Where: side panel › Now playing, heading of the live playback card (shown UPPERCASE) on an episode page, with the episode number on the right (« Episode 7 / 28 ») and the progress bar under it. Meaning: the episode the user is watching right now in the tab. Length: short (≤ 18 chars). Notes: addresses the user like the rest of the UI (FR « Tu regardes »); not the Now playing tab name (panel.tab.nowPlaying).
panel.enablePlatform: Where: side panel › Now playing (tab not on a streaming page), button under the notice. Meaning: enable SyncKai on this optional platform (the browser asks for site access). Placeholders: {platform} = Netflix or Disney+. Length: short (≤ 20 chars). Notes: imperative.
panel.offTargetEnable: Where: side panel › Now playing (tab not on a streaming page), sentence under a separator, below panel.offTargetPlatforms and the chips of the tracked platforms; {path} is a link that opens that settings page. Meaning: these optional platforms can be enabled in Settings. Placeholders: {platforms} = 'Netflix, Disney+ and Prime Video', 'Disney+ and Prime Video' or 'Prime Video'; {path} = 'Settings › Platforms' (translated). Notes: 1 to 3 platforms: avoid agreement.
panel.offTargetPlatforms: Where: side panel › Now playing, notice when the active tab isn't a supported streaming page. Meaning: lists the sites SyncKai tracks. Placeholders: {platforms} = names joined with 'and' in the UI language, e.g. 'Crunchyroll, ADN and Netflix'. Length: medium. Notes: SyncKai untranslated.
panel.open: Where: popup header, tooltip and aria-label of an icon-only button. Meaning: open SyncKai's side panel (Chrome side panel / Firefox sidebar) next to the page. Length: short-medium. Notes: use the browser's usual term for the side panel.
panel.tab.agenda: Where: side panel tab label (calendar icon) and option of Settings › 'Tab on opening'. Meaning: weekly release schedule of the user's series (FR « Agenda », DE « Zeitplan »). Length: short (≤ 12 chars; 2 tabs share ~330 px, 3 options in Settings). Notes: noun.
panel.tab.nowPlaying: Where: side panel tab label (screen icon) and option of Settings › 'Tab on opening'. Meaning: the anime/episode open in the current browser tab, with its live sync progress. Length: short (≤ 12 chars). Notes: quoted in settings.panel.live.help; keep consistent.
panel.tabs: Where: side panel, aria-label of the tab list (Now playing / Schedule), screen readers only. Meaning: the sections of the side panel. Length: short.
popup.abandonFailed: Where: error alert in popup › Activity › Pending syncs. Meaning: 'Abandon' (removing a pending/failed episode sync from the retry queue) failed. Length: medium. Notes: 'sync' = one queued synchronization; informal 'Try again'.
popup.excludeFailed: Where: popup › Watching, red chip on the series row (truncated). Meaning: 'Stop syncing this series' failed. Length: short (chip, ~25 chars). Notes: informal imperative.
popup.hostAccessAllow: Where: button in the amber banner at the top of the popup. Meaning: grant SyncKai access to the Crunchyroll / ADN websites (opens the browser permission prompt). Length: short (~14 chars).
popup.hostAccessDenied: Where: second line of the same banner, after the user refused the permission. Meaning: without access SyncKai can't detect episodes on these sites. Length: medium. Notes: 'track' = follow/sync viewing progress.
popup.hostAccessMissing: Where: bold title of the amber banner at the top of the popup (mainly Firefox). Meaning: the extension lacks permission to access the Crunchyroll and ADN websites. Length: medium. Notes: SyncKai, Crunchyroll, ADN are names; keep ' / '.
popup.ignoreFailed: Where: error alert in popup › Activity › To rate. Meaning: 'Ignore' (skip rating this series) failed. Length: medium. Notes: informal imperative.
popup.includeFailed: Where: popup › Watching, red chip on the series row (truncated). Meaning: 'Resume syncing' for an excluded series failed. Length: short (chip, ~25 chars). Notes: informal imperative.
popup.logoutFailed: Where: alert in Settings › Accounts. Meaning: signing out of the AniList/MyAnimeList account ('Disconnect') failed. Length: medium. Notes: informal imperative.
popup.queueReadFailed: Where: error alert in popup › Activity › Pending syncs. Meaning: the list of syncs waiting to be retried couldn't be read from storage. Length: medium.
popup.ratingsReadFailed: Where: error alert in popup › Activity › To rate. Meaning: the list of series waiting for a rating couldn't be read. Length: medium.
popup.sessionReadFailed: Where: alert on the popup welcome screen or in Settings › Accounts. Meaning: the stored AniList/MyAnimeList sign-in state couldn't be read. Length: medium.
popup.swTimeout: Where: error alert with Retry in popup › Watching. Meaning: the extension's background process didn't answer in time while loading the list. Length: medium. Notes: informal imperative.
popup.swUnreachable: Where: error alerts and feedback almost everywhere (popup, side panel, Settings). Meaning: the page couldn't communicate with the extension's background process. Length: medium. Notes: informal imperative.
popup.syncDisabled: Where: popup › Watching, info chip on the series row after 'Stop syncing this series' (detail in tooltip). Meaning: syncing is now off for this series. Length: short (chip, ~25 chars).
popup.syncDisabledDetail: Where: tooltip of the « Sync turned off » chip; also message of a SyncKai toast on the streaming site. Meaning: the series can be synced again from Settings › Sync › Excluded series. Length: medium. Notes: path must match the translated nav.settings, settings.section.sync and settings.section.exclusions; keep « › ». Changed 2026-10-17: the page moved under Sync.
popup.syncEnabled: Where: popup › Watching, success chip on the series row after 'Resume syncing'. Meaning: syncing is active again for this series. Length: short (chip, ~25 chars).
popup.syncEnabledDetail: Where: tooltip of the 'Sync resumed' chip. Meaning: the next watched episodes of this series will be synced again. Length: medium.
prompt.rating.failed: Where: in-page toast bubble title on the streaming site, after rating with the stars. Meaning: the score could not be saved (per-service details below, with a Retry button). Length: short (bold title, 280 px bubble).
prompt.rating.later: Where: in-page rating bubble on the streaming site, secondary (ghost) button under the stars. Meaning: postpone the rating; the series goes to the popup's Activity › To rate. Length: short (≈ 12 chars).
prompt.rating.question: Where: in-page rating bubble on the streaming site, line under the title, above the 10-star rating. Meaning: asks the user's score for the series just completed. Length: short. Notes: informal 'your' (FR ta, DE deine).
prompt.rating.saved: Where: in-page success toast (pill) on the streaming site, followed by ' · {series title}'. Meaning: the score was saved. Placeholders: {score} = score out of 10, e.g. '8.5/10' (localized decimal). Length: short (≈ 25 chars, never truncated).
prompt.rating.saving: Where: in-page bubble title on the streaming site while the score is being sent; also screen-reader label of the spinner on popup Activity › To rate cards. Meaning: the rating is being saved. Length: short. Notes: keep the ellipsis.
prompt.rating.title: Where: in-page rating bubble title on the streaming site, shown when the last episode was synced. Meaning: the series is now completed (congratulation). Placeholders: {title} = anime title, e.g. 'Frieren'. Length: short + title (bold, 280 px bubble, wraps). Notes: use your language's quotation marks.
prompt.rewatch.failed: Where: in-page toast bubble title on the streaming site, after 'Yes, rewatching'. Meaning: the rewatch could not be recorded (per-service details below, with Retry). 'Rewatch' = watching a completed series again. Length: short.
prompt.rewatch.no: Where: in-page rewatch bubble on the streaming site, secondary (ghost) button. Meaning: answers 'No' to 'Rewatching …?'; SyncKai won't ask again for this series for 30 days. Length: short (≈ 10 chars).
prompt.rewatch.saved: Where: in-page success toast (pill) on the streaming site, followed by ' · {series title}'. Meaning: the series is now marked 'Rewatching' in the list, progress at episode {progress}. Placeholders: {progress} = episode number, e.g. 3. Length: short (≈ 25 chars). Notes: 'ep.' = episode abbreviation.
prompt.rewatch.saving: Where: in-page bubble title on the streaming site while the rewatch is being saved (message = series title). Meaning: in-progress state: 'starting the rewatch…'. Length: short. Notes: keep the ellipsis.
prompt.rewatch.title: Where: in-page bubble on the streaming site (question with No / 'Yes, rewatching' buttons). Meaning: an episode of a series already Completed in the list was watched: is the user watching it again? Placeholders: {title} = anime title. Length: short + title (wraps). Notes: informal you; your language's quotation marks.
prompt.rewatch.yes: Where: in-page rewatch bubble on the streaming site, primary (pink) button. Meaning: confirms watching the series again: sets its list status to 'Rewatching' (AniList REPEATING). Length: short (≈ 18 chars).
queue.abandon: Where: popup Activity › Pending syncs, small button on an item, next to 'Retry'. Meaning: verb: give up this sync, i.e. remove it from the queue without sending it. Length: short (≈ 12 chars).
queue.abandonAria: Where: screen-reader label (aria-label) of the 'Abandon' button on a pending sync. Meaning: give up (discard) the sync of this episode. Placeholders: {title} = anime title + episode, e.g. 'Frieren · S1 E5'. Length: medium (not visible).
queue.failed: Where: popup Activity › Pending syncs, red status line of an item. Meaning: the sync failed and SyncKai stopped retrying automatically (gave up); the user can Retry or Abandon it. Length: short (≈ 25 chars, truncated).
queue.failedHeading: Where: popup › Activity, uppercase section heading (red) above the syncs SyncKai stopped retrying, followed by ' · {count}' added by the code. Meaning: failed syncs (noun), the same failure as queue.failed. Length: short (one word ideally).
queue.gone: Where: popup Activity › Pending syncs, result after 'Retry' (shown as 'Sync failed: …'). Meaning: this pending sync was already removed (synced or discarded meanwhile). Length: short. Notes: 'sync' = noun.
queue.nextAttempt: Where: popup Activity › Pending syncs, status line (clock icon) of an item waiting for an automatic retry. Placeholders: {when} = translated delay from queue.until.*, e.g. 'in 5 min', 'in 2 h', 'shortly'. Length: short (truncated). Notes: {when} already contains the preposition ('in').
queue.pendingHeading: Where: popup › Activity, uppercase section heading (lavender) above the syncs waiting for an automatic retry, followed by ' · {count}' added by the code. Meaning: syncs (noun) on hold until the next try. Length: short (one or two words).
queue.retryAria: Where: screen-reader label (aria-label) of the 'Retry' button on a pending sync. Meaning: retry sending this episode now. Placeholders: {title} = anime title + episode, e.g. 'Frieren · S1 E5'. Length: medium (not visible).
queue.retryFailed: Where: popup Activity › Pending syncs, result after a manual 'Retry' (shown as 'Sync failed: …'). Meaning: the manual retry itself failed unexpectedly; try again later. Length: medium. Notes: informal you (FR tu, DE du).
queue.sessionClosed: Where: popup Activity › Pending syncs, result after 'Retry' (shown as 'Sync failed: …'). Meaning: this pending sync belonged to an account signed out since; it was removed and nothing was written. Length: medium.
queue.until.days_one: Where: inserted as {when} in 'Next try {when}' (popup Activity › Pending syncs). Meaning: next automatic retry in {count} day. Placeholders: {count} = 1. Length: short. Notes: plural pair (_one/_other); lowercase fragment that includes the preposition.
queue.until.days_other: Plural form of queue.until.days_one, inserted as {when} in 'Next try {when}'. Placeholders: {count} = number of days (≥ 2). Length: short. Notes: lowercase fragment that includes the preposition ('in').
queue.until.hours: Where: inserted as {when} in 'Next try {when}' (popup Activity › Pending syncs). Meaning: next automatic retry in about {count} hours. Placeholders: {count} = 1–24. Length: short. Notes: not pluralized: keep an abbreviation ('h'); lowercase fragment that includes the preposition.
queue.until.imminent: Where: inserted as {when} in 'Next try {when}' (popup Activity › Pending syncs). Meaning: the next automatic retry is less than a minute away. Length: short (ideally one word). Notes: lowercase; must read naturally after 'Next try'.
queue.until.minutes: Where: inserted as {when} in 'Next try {when}' (popup Activity › Pending syncs). Meaning: next automatic retry in {count} minutes. Placeholders: {count} = 1–60. Length: short. Notes: not pluralized: keep an abbreviation ('min'); lowercase fragment that includes the preposition.
rating.groupLabel: Where: screen-reader label (aria-label) of the 10-star rating control (in-page rating bubble, popup To rate cards, 'On this page' card, side panel). Meaning: give a score to this anime. Placeholders: {title} = anime title. Length: short (not visible). Notes: 'Rate' = verb.
rating.rateAria: Where: screen-reader label of each half-star button of the 10-star rating. Meaning: give this score. Placeholders: {value} = score from 0.5 to 10 with localized decimal, e.g. '8.5'; {max} = 10. Length: short (not visible). Notes: 'Rate' = verb.
ratings.completed: Where: popup Activity › To rate card, grey line under the series title. Meaning: when the series was completed. Placeholders: {relative} = translated relative time (time.*), e.g. '2 days ago', 'yesterday', 'just now'. Length: short (truncated). Notes: must read naturally with every time.* form.
ratings.heading: Where: popup › Activity, uppercase section heading (pink) above the completed series whose score was postponed, followed by ' · {count}' added by the code. Meaning: series to rate (give a score). Length: short.
ratings.ignoreAria: Where: screen-reader label of the 'Ignore' button on a popup Activity › To rate card. Meaning: dismiss this card without giving a score. Placeholders: {title} = anime title. Length: medium (not visible).
recent.alreadyPendingAria: Where: screen-reader label of the disabled 'To check ↑' button on a recent sync (popup Activity). Meaning: a check card for this series already exists in the 'To check' section above. Placeholders: {title} = anime title + episode, e.g. 'Frieren · E5'. Length: short (not visible).
recent.correct: Where: popup Activity › Recent syncs, small button on each row. Meaning: VERB 'fix': reopen the match to pick another AniList entry/episode if this sync went wrong. Not the adjective 'correct' (= right). Length: short (≈ 12 chars).
recent.correctAria: Where: screen-reader label of the 'Correct' button on a recent sync row. Meaning: VERB: fix the sync of this series (choose another entry). Placeholders: {title} = anime title + episode, e.g. 'Frieren · E5'. Length: short (not visible).
recent.empty: Where: popup Activity › Recent syncs, empty-state text. Meaning: no episode has been synced yet. Length: short. Notes: 'syncs' = noun (synchronizations).
recent.line: Where: popup Activity › Recent syncs, grey second line of a row. Meaning: the AniList/MyAnimeList entry the episode was synced to, and the progress written. Placeholders: {title} = entry title, e.g. 'Frieren'; {progress} = episode number, e.g. 5. Length: short (truncated). Notes: keep '→' and ' · '; lowercase 'episode'.
recent.pending: Where: popup Activity › Recent syncs, disabled button replacing 'Correct'. Meaning: a check card for this series is already waiting in the 'To check' section above (the arrow points to it). Length: short (≈ 12 chars). Notes: keep '↑'; same wording as the 'To check' section (inline.toCheck).
recent.title: Where: popup Activity tab, section heading (13 px). Meaning: the last episodes SyncKai synced to AniList/MyAnimeList. Length: short. Notes: 'syncs' = noun.
review.candidatesAria: Where: aria-label (screen readers) of the group of candidate AniList entries in a 'To check' card (popup › Activity). Meaning: pick the entry that matches the episode. Length: short.
review.deferredNote: Where: small grey note in a 'To check' card while a correction is pending. Meaning: a newly watched episode is waiting and will be applied once the user decides ('on hold' = set aside, not the list status). Placeholders: {number} = episode number, e.g. 6 ('?' if unknown). Length: medium.
review.dismissFailed: Where: error message in a 'To check' card, under 'Action failed'. Meaning: 'Ignore' (dismissing the to-check card) failed. Length: medium. Notes: 'review' = the to-check item (FR 'vérification'); informal imperative.
review.displayed: Where: header of a 'To check' card, e.g. 'S2 · E5 (shown as E30) · Crunchyroll'. Meaning: the platform displays this episode under another (absolute) number. Placeholders: {number} = displayed number, e.g. 30. Length: short. Notes: keep 'E' (episode): the 'S2 · E5' part is not translated.
review.empty: Where: popup › Activity › 'To check' section, empty state next to a check icon. Meaning: no uncertain match is waiting for the user. Length: medium.
review.episodeOnEntry: Where: label of the number field in a 'To check' card (followed by '/ 12'). Meaning: episode number to record on the selected AniList entry (may differ from the platform's number). Length: short-medium.
review.episodes: Where: details under each candidate entry in a 'To check' card, e.g. 'TV · 12 ep. · 2023'. Placeholders: {count} = episode count of the entry. Length: short. Notes: not plural-aware (no _one/_other): use an abbreviation valid for any number.
review.excludeTitle: Where: tooltip of the « Stop syncing » button in a « To check » card. Meaning: excludes the whole series (every season) from syncing; undo in Settings › Sync › Excluded series. Length: medium. Notes: path must match the translated nav.settings, settings.section.sync and settings.section.exclusions; keep « › ». Changed 2026-10-17: the page moved under Sync.
review.format.movie: Where: format label in candidate details of a 'To check' card. Meaning: AniList format MOVIE (feature film). Length: short.
review.format.special: Where: format label in candidate details of a 'To check' card. Meaning: AniList format SPECIAL (special episode). Length: short. Notes: TV, ONA, OVA stay untranslated nearby.
review.format.tvShort: Where: format label in candidate details of a 'To check' card. Meaning: AniList format TV_SHORT (TV series with short episodes). Length: short.
review.invalidEpisode: Where: bold error title in a 'To check' card when the typed episode number is invalid (message below). Length: short.
review.invalidMin: Where: error message under 'Invalid episode' in a 'To check' card. Meaning: the episode number must be 1 or more. Length: medium. Notes: informal imperative.
review.invalidRange: Where: error message under 'Invalid episode' in a 'To check' card. Meaning: the number must be between 1 and the selected entry's episode count. Placeholders: {max} = that count, e.g. 12. Length: medium.
review.noCandidates: Where: 'To check' card, in place of the list of candidate entries. Meaning: SyncKai has no suggestion; search for the entry with the field below. Length: medium. Notes: informal imperative.
review.previousNote: Where: bold note in a 'To check' card after a sync was corrected to another entry. Meaning: SyncKai doesn't undo the earlier write; fix the wrong entry yourself. Placeholders: {title} = previously used AniList entry; {progress} = episode number written there. Length: long. Notes: informal tone.
review.results: Where: small heading above search results in a 'To check' card (shown in capitals via CSS; write normal case). Placeholders: {count} = number of results, e.g. 5. Length: short.
review.search: Where: aria-label (screen readers) of the magnifier submit button next to the search field in a 'To check' card. Meaning: run the search (verb). Length: short.
review.searchAria: Where: aria-label (screen readers) of the search field in a 'To check' card. Meaning: search AniList for another entry. Length: medium.
review.searchFailed: Where: bold error title in a 'To check' card (error message below). Meaning: the AniList search failed. Length: short.
review.searchPlaceholder: Where: placeholder of the search field in a 'To check' card. Meaning: search for a different AniList entry than the suggested ones. Length: short (narrow field). Notes: ends with '…'.
settings.about.source: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Help & about › About card, link row ('GitHub' shown on the right, opens the repository in a new tab). Meaning: the extension's source code. Changed 2026-10-17: 'on GitHub' moved to the right of the row. Length: short.
settings.account.connected: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Accounts, grey subtitle under the user's account name (or under the service name) in the account card. Placeholders: {service} = 'AniList' or 'MyAnimeList'. Meaning: this account is connected to SyncKai. Notes: keep ' · '; the adjective may agree with 'account'. Length: short.
settings.account.loading: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Accounts, aria-label (screen reader only) of the placeholder shown while the account loads. Placeholders: {service} = 'AniList' or 'MyAnimeList'. Meaning: the account's profile is loading. Length: short.
settings.account.logout: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Accounts, red text button at the right of each connected account row. Meaning: sign out of AniList/MyAnimeList in SyncKai (opposite of 'Connect'). Verb. Length: short, ≤ 12 chars.
settings.account.logoutAria: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Accounts, aria-label (screen reader only) of the 'Disconnect' button. Placeholders: {service} = 'AniList' or 'MyAnimeList'. Meaning: sign out of that service in SyncKai. Notes: same verb as settings.account.logout. Length: short.
settings.account.notConnected: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Accounts, grey subtitle under 'AniList' / 'MyAnimeList' when signed out (a 'Connect' button is at the right). Meaning: the account is not connected to SyncKai. Length: short, ≤ 20 chars.
settings.account.openProfile: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Accounts, tooltip (title attribute) on the user's account name, a link opening their profile page in a new tab. Placeholders: {service} = 'AniList' or 'MyAnimeList'. Notes: first person ('my profile'). Length: short.
settings.airing.checkNow: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Notifications › New episodes card, small text button right of the status line ('Last checked: 5 min ago · …'). Meaning: run the new-episode check now. Imperative. Length: short, ≤ 14 chars.
settings.airing.checkTitle: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Notifications › New episodes, tooltip (title) of the 'Check now' button while release alerts are on. Meaning: query AniList's airing schedule right away for newly aired episodes. 'AniList' untranslated. Length: medium.
settings.airing.checking: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Notifications › New episodes, status line text while the manual check runs (replaces 'Last checked: …'). Meaning: check in progress. Ends with an ellipsis (…). Length: short.
settings.airing.enableFirst: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Notifications › New episodes, grey line under the status line « Last checked: … », next to the greyed « Check now » button, while release alerts are off. Meaning: turn on the « Release alerts » switch above to check for new episodes. Informal you (FR tu, DE du). Changed 2026-10-17 (now visible text, was only a tooltip). Length: one or two lines.
settings.airing.unavailable: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Notifications › New episodes status line, after 'failed: ' → 'Last checked: just now · failed: service unavailable, try again'. Meaning: the extension's background service didn't answer the check. Notes: lowercase fragment (DE nouns capitalized), no final period. Informal you (FR tu, DE du).
settings.autoSync.label: Where: Settings (popup & side panel): Settings home › Quick settings, and Sync, Automatic card; toggle label. Meaning: automatic synchronization of watched episodes to AniList/MyAnimeList (noun phrase, not an imperative). Length: short, ≤ 25 chars.
settings.backup.export: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › Backup card, outlined button; also the button of the Export section on the Backup page (full tab). Meaning: verb, export (download) a backup file of SyncKai's data. Length: short, ≤ 14 chars.
settings.backup.exportFailed: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › Backup card and the Backup page, red error alert. Meaning: the backup file couldn't be created or downloaded. Informal you (FR tu, DE du). Length: medium.
settings.backup.exportTitle: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › Backup, tooltip (title) of 'Export' in the side panel; also the bold title of the Export card on the Backup page (full tab). Meaning: clicking downloads a .json backup file directly. Keep '.json'. Length: short.
settings.backup.exportTabTitle: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › Backup, tooltip (title) of 'Export' in the popup (a download would close it). Meaning: opens the 'Backup' page (that page's title) in a new browser tab, which downloads a .json file. Keep '.json'. Length: medium.
settings.backup.exported: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › Backup card, green status text with a check mark, shown for 2 s after a successful export (side panel; the popup exports via the Backup page). Meaning: past participle, 'the backup has been exported'. Length: short, ≤ 14 chars.
settings.backup.help: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › Backup card, grey text above the Export / Import buttons. Meaning: what a backup file contains: settings, matches (remembered season → AniList entry links), excluded series and sync history; never the AniList / MyAnimeList sign-ins. Changed 2026-10-17: 'in one file', full service names. Length: long, wraps.
settings.backup.import: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › Backup card, outlined button next to 'Export', followed by an ↗ arrow (it opens the Backup page in a new tab). Meaning: verb, restore data from a backup file. Changed 2026-10-17: no ellipsis (the arrow says a page opens). Length: short, ≤ 14 chars.
settings.backup.importTitle: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › Backup, tooltip (title) of 'Import…'. Meaning: opens the 'Backup' page (that page's title) in a new browser tab, where the file is chosen. Length: medium.
settings.backup.crImport: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › Import section, bold title of the card holding the Crunchyroll / ADN / Netflix buttons. Meaning: bring in the user's past viewing history from a streaming site to update AniList/MyAnimeList. Length: medium, ≤ 30 chars (wraps).
settings.delay.aria_one: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Notifications › New episodes, aria-label (screen reader only) of each Delay button. Placeholders: {count} = 0, 1, 3 or 6 (hours). Meaning: the release alert comes {count} hour(s) after the episode airs in Japan. Notes: the 'one' form may also be used for 0 (e.g. French).
settings.delay.aria_other: Plural form of settings.delay.aria_one (e.g. '3 hours after airing'); screen-reader label of a Delay button; {count} is 0, 1, 3 or 6.
settings.delay.label: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Notifications › New episodes, visible text of each button of the Delay control (0 h | 1 h | 3 h | 6 h). Placeholders: {hours} = 0, 1, 3 or 6. Meaning: hours after the Japanese airing. Length: very short, ≤ 6 chars: use your hour abbreviation (DE 'Std.').
settings.delay.title: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Notifications › New episodes, row label left of the 0 h / 1 h / 3 h / 6 h control (greyed while release alerts are off). Meaning: extra time added after the estimated release time before the release alert is sent (noun phrase). Changed 2026-10-17 (was « Delay »). Length: short, ≤ 16 chars so the control fits on the same line.
settings.exclusions.empty: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Sync › Excluded series page, grey text when the list is empty. Meaning: no series has been excluded from syncing. Ends with a period. Length: short.
settings.exclusions.loadError: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Sync › Excluded series page, red error alert. Meaning: the stored list of series excluded from syncing couldn't be read. Length: medium.
settings.exclusions.loading: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Sync › Excluded series page, aria-label (screen reader only) of the loading placeholder. Meaning: the list of series excluded from syncing is loading. Length: short.
settings.exclusions.reactivate: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Sync › Excluded series page, small text button at the right of each series. Meaning: turn syncing back on for this series (remove it from the exclusions). Verb. Length: short, ≤ 14 chars.
settings.exclusions.reactivateAria: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Sync › Excluded series page, aria-label (screen reader only) of the 'Re-enable' button. Placeholders: {title} = series title, e.g. 'Frieren'. Meaning: resume syncing that series. Length: short.
settings.exclusions.reactivateFailed: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Sync › Excluded series page, red error alert after 'Re-enable' failed. Meaning: syncing couldn't be turned back on for the series. Informal you (FR tu, DE du). Length: medium.
settings.help.clear: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Help & about › Help card, screen-reader label of the red 'Clear' button (settings.matchDiag.clear) on the 'Error log' row. Meaning: verb, delete all entries of the error log stored in this browser. Length: short (not shown).
settings.help.clearFailed: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Help & about, red status line under the buttons, after 'Clear log' failed. Meaning: the error log couldn't be cleared. Length: short.
settings.help.cleared: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Help & about, green status line with a check mark, shown for 2.5 s after 'Clear log'. Meaning: the error log has been cleared. Length: short.
settings.help.copied: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Help & about, green status line with a check mark, shown for 2.5 s after copying. Meaning: the diagnostic report was copied to the clipboard. Length: short.
settings.help.copy: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Help & about › Help card, outlined button on the 'Diagnostic report' row. Meaning: copy the diagnostic report to the clipboard. Quoted at the end of the GitHub issue template (help.issue.body): keep consistent. Changed 2026-10-17: 'the report' (the row title already says 'Diagnostic report'). Length: short, ≤ 20 chars.
settings.help.copyFailed: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Help & about, red status line after 'Copy diagnostic report' failed. Meaning: the report couldn't be copied to the clipboard. Informal you (FR tu, DE du). Length: short.
settings.help.errors_one: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Help & about, grey status line under the buttons. Placeholders: {count} = number of errors recorded in the local error log. Meaning: errors stored in this browser. Keep {count} as digits: in some languages the 'one' form also covers 0 or 21, 31…
settings.help.errors_other: Plural form of settings.help.errors_one (e.g. '3 errors recorded'), grey status line in Settings › Help & about.
settings.help.noErrors: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Help & about › Help card, grey status line under 'Error log' when the log is empty. Meaning: no error recorded in this browser. Length: short.
settings.help.report: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Help & about › Help card, link row (bug icon, ↗) that opens a pre-filled GitHub issue in a new tab. Meaning: report a bug or problem. Length: short.
settings.matchDiag.title: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Help & about, heading of a section shown ONLY in development builds (never in the published extension). Meaning: list of the recent decisions SyncKai made when matching a streaming season to an AniList entry, for the developer. Length: short, ≤ 30 chars. Notes: sentence case, no final period.
settings.matchDiag.text: Where: Settings › Help & about › 'Matching diagnostic' section (development builds only), help paragraph above the list, next to the 'Clear' button. Meaning: the section exists only in development builds; it lists the last 50 decisions of the AniList matching (newest first), kept in memory until the browser is closed; one decision can be copied as JSON to become a test case of the matching test corpus. Length: long, wraps. Notes: '50' is a fixed number; 'JSON' is a format name; informal you (FR tu, DE du).
settings.matchDiag.empty: Where: Settings › Help & about › 'Matching diagnostic' section (development builds only), single line inside the list card when nothing has been recorded. Meaning: no matching decision has been recorded since the browser started (or since the list was cleared). Length: short. Notes: no final period.
settings.matchDiag.copy: Where: Settings › Help & about › 'Matching diagnostic' section (development builds only), small outlined button at the end of each decision row. Meaning: verb, copy this decision to the clipboard (as JSON). Length: very short, ≤ 10 chars (a time and the series title share the row).
settings.matchDiag.copyTitle: Where: tooltip of the 'Copy' button of each row in Settings › Help & about › 'Matching diagnostic' (development builds only). Meaning: copies this one matching decision to the clipboard as JSON text. Notes: 'JSON' is a format name; no final period.
settings.matchDiag.copyAll: Where: Settings › Help & about › 'Matching diagnostic' section (development builds only), small outlined button next to 'Clear', above the list. Meaning: verb phrase, copy every recorded decision to the clipboard at once (one JSON array). Its label is replaced by 'Copied' for 2 s. Length: short, ≤ 16 chars (shares the row with the section text).
settings.matchDiag.copyAllTitle: Where: tooltip of the 'Copy all' button in Settings › Help & about › 'Matching diagnostic' (development builds only). Meaning: copies all the recorded matching decisions (plural) to the clipboard as one JSON text. Notes: 'JSON' is a format name; no final period.
settings.matchDiag.copied: Where: Settings › Help & about › 'Matching diagnostic' (development builds only), replaces the 'Copy' button label of the row (or the 'Copy all' label) for 2 s, with a check mark. Meaning: the decision was copied to the clipboard. Length: very short, ≤ 14 chars.
settings.matchDiag.copyFailed: Where: Settings › Help & about › 'Matching diagnostic' (development builds only), red status line under the help paragraph. Meaning: copying the decision to the clipboard failed (also shown when 'Copy all' fails). Length: short. Notes: ends with a period.
settings.matchDiag.clear: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Help & about: red button 'Clear' of the 'Error log' row, and (development builds only) of the 'Matching diagnostic' and 'Debug trace' sections. Meaning: verb, delete the listed entries. Length: very short, ≤ 10 chars.
settings.matchDiag.candidates: Where: Settings › Help & about › 'Matching diagnostic' (development builds only), end of the third line of a decision row, after the platform data (e.g. 'season 2016 · 12 ep · Candidates: 8'). Meaning: number of AniList entries compared for this decision. Placeholders: {count} = a number (digits). Notes: label + colon + number so that no plural form is needed; no final period.
settings.matchDiag.noEntry: Where: Settings › Help & about › 'Matching diagnostic' (development builds only), second line of a decision row, after an arrow ('→ No entry · resolved · …'). Meaning: the decision picked no AniList entry (not found, or ignored). Length: very short. Notes: 'entry' = the anime's page on AniList, as in the term sheet; no final period.
settings.debugTrace.title: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Help & about, heading of a section shown ONLY in development builds (never in the published extension), below 'Matching diagnostic'. Meaning: chronological record of what the extension did (pages, background service worker, requests to AniList and MyAnimeList), for the developer. Length: short, ≤ 30 chars. Notes: sentence case, no final period; 'trace' as in a debugging trace (a timeline of events), not a footprint.
settings.debugTrace.text: Where: Settings › Help & about › 'Debug trace' section (development builds only), help paragraph at the top of the card. Meaning: the section exists only in development builds; it lists events (what happened on the streaming pages, in the extension's background service worker and in the requests to AniList and MyAnimeList), newest first, kept in memory until the browser is closed; no token, cookie or account identifier is ever recorded; the whole trace can be copied as JSON and pasted when reporting a problem. Length: long, wraps. Notes: 'service worker' is the browser's technical term (keep it in English unless your term sheet says otherwise); 'JSON' is a format name; informal you (FR tu, DE du).
settings.debugTrace.empty: Where: Settings › Help & about › 'Debug trace' (development builds only), single line inside the list card when nothing is recorded (or nothing in the selected category). Meaning: no event has been recorded since the browser started, since the trace was cleared, or for this filter. Length: short. Notes: no final period.
settings.debugTrace.copy: Where: Settings › Help & about › 'Debug trace' (development builds only), small outlined button next to the category filter. Meaning: verb + object, copy the WHOLE trace (every event) to the clipboard as JSON. Length: short, ≤ 20 chars (the filter and 'Clear' share the row, the row may wrap).
settings.debugTrace.copied: Where: Settings › Help & about › 'Debug trace' (development builds only), replaces the 'Copy trace' button label for 2 s, with a check mark. Meaning: the trace was copied to the clipboard. Length: very short, ≤ 14 chars. Notes: if your language agrees the participle, it agrees with 'trace' (FR « Copiée »).
settings.debugTrace.copyFailed: Where: Settings › Help & about › 'Debug trace' (development builds only), red status line under the buttons. Meaning: copying the trace to the clipboard failed. Length: short. Notes: ends with a period.
settings.debugTrace.verbose: Where: Settings › Help & about › 'Debug trace' (development builds only), label of a switch row. Meaning: when on, the trace keeps more events (1000 instead of 300) and also records every informational log line of the extension, not only warnings and errors. Length: short, ≤ 45 chars, may wrap. Notes: 'log line' = a line of the extension's technical log; no final period.
settings.debugTrace.count: Where: Settings › Help & about › 'Debug trace' (development builds only), small line under the buttons (e.g. 'Events: 42 / 300'). Meaning: number of events recorded / maximum kept (300, or 1000 in verbose mode). Placeholders: {count} and {max} = numbers already formatted for the language. Notes: label + colon + numbers so that no plural form is needed; no final period.
settings.debugTrace.allCategories: Where: Settings › Help & about › 'Debug trace' (development builds only), first option of the category filter (a drop-down list; the other options are technical names left in English: page, shortcut, sync, ui, account, alarm, log, network, message). Meaning: show events of every category. Length: short, ≤ 24 chars.
settings.debugTrace.filterAria: Where: accessible name (screen readers) of the category drop-down list in Settings › Help & about › 'Debug trace' (development builds only). Meaning: the list filters the displayed events by category. Notes: no final period.
settings.language.auto: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Language, first radio option, pinned above the language list. Meaning: follow the browser's language. Same word reused in the home summary 'Automatic (English)'. Length: short, ≤ 20 chars.
settings.language.autoDetail: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Language, grey subtitle under 'Automatic'. Placeholders: {language} = name of the detected language in that language (endonym), e.g. 'Deutsch', 'Français'; English when the browser's language isn't supported. Length: short, single truncated line.
settings.language.groupLabel: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Language, section heading above the language list (CSS uppercases it: write normal case); also the accessible name of the radio group. Meaning: language of SyncKai's interface. Length: short.
settings.language.helpTranslate: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Language, external link row at the bottom of the list (hidden until a translation-site link is configured). Meaning: invitation to help translate the extension. 'SyncKai' untranslated. Imperative/infinitive. Length: medium.
settings.language.noResult: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Language, message replacing the list when the search matches no language. Length: short.
settings.language.searchPlaceholder: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Language, placeholder and aria-label of the search field above the language list (shown with 8+ languages). Meaning: type to filter languages. Length: short, ≤ 30 chars (field ~300 px).
settings.loadError: Where: Settings (popup & side panel), red error alert replacing the page content. Meaning: the stored settings couldn't be read; closing and reopening SyncKai (popup or side panel) reloads them. Informal you (FR tu, DE du). Length: medium, two short sentences.
settings.loading: Where: Settings (popup & side panel), aria-label (screen reader only) of the placeholder shown while settings load. Length: short.
settings.mappings.displayed: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Sync › Matches page, each match, grey fragment of the line under the AniList title, after the episode count ('28 ep. · '). Meaning: progress is computed from the episode number displayed by the platform (e.g. One Piece E1180), as opposed to settings.mappings.season. Notes: lowercase fragment; may be followed by ', offset of 24'.
settings.mappings.empty: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Sync › Matches page, grey text when nothing is remembered yet. Meaning: no match yet (match = remembered link between a platform season and an AniList entry; FR « correspondance », DE « Zuordnung »). Length: short.
settings.mappings.entryFallback: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Sync › Matches page, each match, link text to the AniList page when the anime's title is unknown. Placeholders: {id} = AniList numeric ID, e.g. 21. Meaning: 'entry' = the anime's page on AniList (FR « fiche »). Keep '#'. Length: short.
settings.mappings.forget: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Sync › Matches page, each match, red text button at the right of each remembered match. Meaning: delete this match so it is worked out again at the next episode. Verb. Length: short, ≤ 12 chars.
settings.mappings.forgetAria: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Sync › Matches page, each match, aria-label (screen reader only) of the 'Forget' button. Placeholders: {label} = the platform season, e.g. 'One Piece · S2 (East Blue)'. Meaning: forget the match for that season. Length: short.
settings.mappings.forgetTitle: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Sync › Matches page, each match, tooltip (title) of each 'Forget' button. Meaning: SyncKai will work out the AniList entry again the next time an episode of that season is watched. Length: medium.
settings.mappings.hide: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Sync › Matches page, toggle text (with chevron) at the right of the header while the list is expanded; collapses it. Opposite of 'Manage'. Length: short, ≤ 12 chars.
settings.mappings.loadError: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Sync › Matches page, red error alert. Meaning: the remembered matches (season → AniList entry links) couldn't be read. Length: medium.
settings.mappings.offset: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Sync › Matches page, each match, grey fragment of the line under the AniList title, after the episode count ('28 ep. · '). Placeholders: {source} = settings.mappings.displayed or .season (lowercase); {offset} = integer subtracted from it to get the AniList episode, e.g. 24 (can be negative). Example: 'displayed number, offset of 24'. Lowercase fragment.
settings.mappings.reset: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Sync › Matches page, Danger zone, red outlined button in the 'Matches' row. Meaning: forget all remembered matches (asks for confirmation first). Verb. Length: short, ≤ 20 chars.
settings.mappings.resetConfirm: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Sync › Matches page, Danger zone, yellow inline question shown left of the Cancel / Confirm buttons after 'Reset all'. Meaning: confirm forgetting every remembered match. Ends with a question mark. Length: short, ≤ 28 chars.
settings.mappings.saveFailed: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Sync › Matches page, red error alert after 'Forget' or 'Reset all' failed. Meaning: the change to the matches couldn't be saved. Informal you (FR tu, DE du). Length: medium.
settings.mappings.season: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Sync › Matches page, each match, grey fragment of the line under the AniList title, after the episode count ('28 ep. · '). Meaning: the match uses the episode's number WITHIN its season (e.g. episode 25 of the season), not the season's own number; contrast with settings.mappings.displayed. Notes: lowercase fragment; may be followed by ', offset of N'.
settings.notif.alertsAlways: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Notifications, grey note under the « On the playback page » card. Meaning: an error, or a series whose match must be checked, always shows a message on the page, whatever style is chosen. Changed 2026-10-17. Length: one or two lines.
settings.notif.alertsOnly.desc: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Notifications, grey description of the « Alerts only » card. Meaning: no message after a normal sync; a bubble only when something went wrong or an episode's match must be checked (FR « à vérifier »). No final period. Changed 2026-10-17. Length: two or three lines.
settings.notif.alertsOnly.title: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Notifications › On-page notifications, title of the 3rd radio card; also starts the home summary ('Alerts only · alerts on time'). Meaning: on the streaming page, show only warnings needing action (not release alerts; DE « Nur Warnungen »). Length: short, ≤ 18 chars.
settings.notif.detailed.desc: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Notifications, grey description of the « Detailed » card. Meaning: after each sync, a message bubble on the playback page with the episode and the result on AniList and on MyAnimeList. No final period. Changed 2026-10-17. Length: two lines.
settings.notif.detailed.title: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Notifications › On-page notifications, title of the 2nd radio card; also starts the home summary ('Detailed · alerts +3 h'). Meaning: verbose notifications. Notes: adjective qualifying 'notifications' (FR « Détaillées »). Length: short, ≤ 16 chars.
settings.notif.discreet.desc: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Notifications, grey description of the « Discreet » card (with a small drawing of a video and a pill in its corner). Meaning: after a sync, a small pill (rounded label) shows for a few seconds in a corner of the video. No final period. Changed 2026-10-17. Length: two lines.
settings.notif.discreet.title: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Notifications › On-page notifications, title of the 1st radio card (with a 'Recommended' badge); also starts the home summary ('Discreet · alerts on time'). Meaning: unobtrusive notifications. Notes: adjective qualifying 'notifications' (FR « Discrètes »). Length: short, ≤ 16 chars.
settings.offsets.aria: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Platforms › Estimated release time, screen-reader name of each editable minutes value (e.g. « +60 »; typed with the keyboard, ↑ ↓ change it by 15). Placeholders: {platform} = 'Crunchyroll', 'ADN', 'Netflix', 'Disney+' or 'Prime Video'. Meaning: how many minutes after the Japanese TV broadcast episodes appear on that platform. Length: medium.
settings.offsets.help: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Platforms, grey note under the « Estimated release time » card. Meaning: the minutes are counted from the Japanese TV broadcast; the side panel's Schedule tab (panel.tab.agenda: use the same word) and the release alerts use them; one series can be set apart from its row in the Schedule (« Adjust time »). Changed 2026-10-17 (alerts follow the Schedule time since decision 17). Length: two or three lines.
settings.offsets.title: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Platforms, section heading above one row per platform (Crunchyroll, ADN, Netflix, Disney+, Prime Video), each with − / + buttons around « +60 min » (CSS uppercases it: write normal case). Meaning: when an episode is expected on each platform, in minutes after the Japanese broadcast. Changed 2026-10-17 (moved from the Schedule card). Length: short, ≤ 30 chars.
settings.offsets.unit: Where: unit after each minutes field (Settings › Notifications & schedule › Schedule, popup & side panel) and in the side panel's Schedule 'Adjust time' form. Meaning: abbreviation of minutes. Length: very short, ≤ 5 chars (DE 'Min.').
settings.percent: Where: Settings (popup & side panel): value next to the percentage slider in Settings › Sync, its screen-reader value, and the home summary ('at 85%'). Placeholders: {value} = integer 70–98, e.g. 85. Notes: follow your locale's percent convention (EN '85%', FR/DE '85 %'). Length: very short.
settings.percentage.fallbackHelp: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Sync, Automatic card, help under the slider when 'At the start of the credits' is chosen. Meaning: the percentage is used on platforms that don't report when the end credits start (ADN). No final period. Length: medium.
settings.percentage.fallbackLabel: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Sync, Automatic card, label of the 70–98 % slider when the credits option is chosen (value shown at right). Meaning: backup percentage watched after which an episode counts as watched, used when credits are unknown. Length: short, ≤ 24 chars.
settings.percentage.help: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Sync, Automatic card, help under the slider when 'At a fixed percentage' is chosen. Meaning: a new percentage takes effect from the next episode watched. No final period. Length: short.
settings.percentage.label: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Sync, Automatic card, label of the 70–98 % slider when 'At a fixed percentage' is chosen (value shown at right). Meaning: share of the episode watched after which it counts as watched. Length: short, ≤ 24 chars.
settings.player.help: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Platforms, grey note under the « Preferred player » card. Meaning: decides which streaming site the « Open » button (common.open, quote its translation) uses when the anime is on several of the platforms turned on. Changed 2026-10-17 (adds « active »). Length: two lines.
settings.player.label: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Platforms, section heading above the « Open episodes on » card (CSS uppercases it: write normal case). Meaning: preferred streaming platform to watch on (« player » = streaming service, not a media player app). Length: short, ≤ 20 chars.
settings.entry.help: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Accounts, grey help under « Default entry page ». Meaning: which page (AniList or MyAnimeList) opens when the user clicks an anime's title or cover; since 2026-10-17 the same setting also picks which list the popup's « My series » shows (the AniList / MAL selector above the list was removed). Quote « My series » with the exact translation of watching.mySeries. Changed 2026-10-17: the « when both accounts are connected » part moved to settings.entry.unavailable. Length: one line, may wrap to two.
settings.entry.label: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Accounts, row label left of a segmented control (AniList | MAL). Meaning: which site's page of an anime opens by default ('entry' = the anime's page on AniList or MyAnimeList, FR « fiche »). Length: short, ≤ 24 chars.
settings.netflix.helpOff: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Platforms, Netflix row, help under the toggle while it is off. Meaning: only anime whose AniList entry links to Netflix are synced; turning it on shows a browser permission prompt for netflix.com. Keep 'netflix.com'. No final period. Length: long, wraps.
settings.netflix.helpOn: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Platforms, Netflix row, help under the toggle while it is on. Meaning: only anime whose AniList entry links to Netflix are synced, also in Netflix tabs opened before it was turned on. No final period. Length: long, wraps.
settings.netflix.denied: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Platforms, Netflix row, red message under the toggle. Meaning: the user refused the browser's permission prompt for netflix.com, so Netflix syncing stays off. Keep 'netflix.com'. Length: medium.
settings.netflix.disabled: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Platforms, Netflix row, grey status under the toggle after turning it off. Meaning: Netflix syncing is off, but already open Netflix tabs keep tracking until reloaded. Informal you (FR tu, DE du). Length: medium, wraps.
settings.netflix.error: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Platforms, Netflix row, red message under the toggle. Meaning: granting or removing the Netflix access permission failed. Informal you (FR tu, DE du). Length: medium.
