settings.disney.helpOff: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Platforms, Disney+ row, help under the toggle while it is off. Meaning: only Japanese anime whose AniList entry links to Disney+ are synced; turning it on shows a browser permission prompt for disneyplus.com. Keep the domain. No final period. Length: long.
settings.disney.helpOn: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Platforms, Disney+ row, help under the toggle while it is on. Meaning: only Japanese anime whose AniList entry links to Disney+ are synced; in a Disney+ tab opened before turning it on, tracking starts at the next episode. No final period. Length: long.
settings.disney.denied: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Platforms, Disney+ row, red message under the toggle. Meaning: the user refused the browser's permission prompt for disneyplus.com, so Disney+ syncing stays off. Keep 'disneyplus.com'. Length: medium.
settings.disney.disabled: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Platforms, Disney+ row, grey status under the toggle after turning it off. Meaning: Disney+ syncing is off, but already open Disney+ tabs keep tracking until reloaded. Informal you (FR tu, DE du). Length: medium, wraps.
settings.disney.error: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Platforms, Disney+ row, red message under the toggle. Meaning: granting or removing the Disney+ access permission failed. Informal you (FR tu, DE du). Length: medium.
settings.prime.helpOff: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Platforms, Prime Video row, help under the toggle while it is off. Meaning: only anime are synced: titles in Prime Video's own 'Anime' genre, or animated titles that have a Japanese audio track or whose title exactly matches an AniList entry; turning it on shows a browser permission prompt for primevideo.com. Keep the domain. No final period. Length: long.
settings.prime.helpOn: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Platforms, Prime Video row, help under the toggle while it is on. Meaning: SyncKai only reads the data the Prime Video page already receives from the site (it sends no request of its own); in a Prime Video tab opened before turning it on, tracking starts at the next episode. No final period. Length: long.
settings.prime.denied: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Platforms, Prime Video row, red message under the toggle. Meaning: the user refused the browser's permission prompt for primevideo.com, so Prime Video syncing stays off. Keep 'primevideo.com'. Length: medium.
settings.prime.disabled: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Platforms, Prime Video row, grey status under the toggle after turning it off. Meaning: Prime Video syncing is off, but already open Prime Video tabs keep tracking until reloaded. Informal you (FR tu, DE du). Length: medium, wraps.
settings.prime.error: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Platforms, Prime Video row, red message under the toggle. Meaning: granting or removing the Prime Video access permission failed. Informal you (FR tu, DE du). Length: medium.
settings.ratingPrompt.help: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Notifications › On-page notifications, help under 'Offer to rate…'. Meaning: a bubble asking 'Your rating?' (prompt.rating.question) appears on the page when a series becomes Completed in the user's list (page.status.COMPLETED): reuse both translations. Length: medium.
settings.ratingPrompt.label: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Notifications › On-page notifications, toggle label. Meaning: when the user finishes a series (list status Completed), offer to give it a score. Length: medium, one line.
settings.recommended: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Notifications, small green pill badge next to the 'Discreet' option title. Meaning: this option is recommended. Length: short, ≤ 14 chars.
settings.section.about: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Help & about, section heading above the version and source-code rows (CSS uppercases it: write normal case). Meaning: information about the extension. Length: short.
settings.section.accounts: Where: Settings (popup & side panel): title of a Settings home category row (summary 'AniList ✓ · MAL ✓') and of that sub-page (truncated in the top bar). Meaning: the user's AniList and MyAnimeList accounts. Length: short, ≤ 20 chars.
settings.section.airing: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Notifications, section heading for release alerts (toggle, Delay, Check now); CSS uppercases it, write normal case. Meaning: newly released episodes. Length: short.
settings.section.backup: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data, section heading above the Export / Import… card (CSS uppercases it: write normal case). Meaning: backup (noun) of SyncKai's data; same word as the 'Backup' page title. Length: short.
settings.section.exclusions: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Sync: row that opens the Excluded series page, and that page’s title (top bar). Quoted elsewhere as « Settings › Sync › Excluded series »: keep identical. Length: short, ≤ 24 chars.
settings.section.help: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Help & about, section heading above the diagnostic-report and report-a-problem buttons (CSS uppercases it: write normal case). Quoted in the GitHub issue template path 'Settings › Help › …'. Length: short.
settings.section.language: Where: Settings (popup & side panel): title of a Settings home category row (summary shows the chosen language) and of that sub-page. Meaning: interface language. Length: short, ≤ 20 chars.
settings.section.mappings: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Sync: title of the Matches sub-page (top bar). Meaning: remembered links between a platform season and an AniList entry (FR « Correspondances », DE « Zuordnungen »). Length: short, ≤ 20 chars.
settings.section.notifications: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Notifications, section heading above the three notification style cards (Discreet / Detailed / Alerts only) and the « Offer to rate » switch (CSS uppercases it: write normal case). Meaning: messages SyncKai shows on the streaming site's playback page after a sync, not browser notifications. Changed 2026-10-17 (was « On-page notifications »). Length: short, ≤ 30 chars.
settings.section.sync: Where: Settings (popup & side panel): title of the Sync category (home row and top bar), also quoted in paths (« Settings › Sync › Excluded series », popup.syncDisabledDetail, review.excludeTitle) and as the back button of its sub-pages Matches and Excluded series. Meaning: synchronization (noun) with AniList/MyAnimeList. Length: short, ≤ 20 chars.
settings.shortcut.azertyKey: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Shortcuts rows and home summary, hint after a digit key: 'Alt+Shift+1 (& key on AZERTY)'. Currently shown only when the UI is French, so other languages never display it. Placeholders: {char} = character printed on that key on AZERTY keyboards, e.g. '&'. Length: short.
settings.shortcut.edit: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Shortcuts, link-style button at the right of a row whose key is set; opens the browser's keyboard-shortcuts page. Meaning: change the key (verb). Quoted in settings.shortcuts.help: keep identical. Length: short, ≤ 12 chars.
settings.shortcut.editAria: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Shortcuts, aria-label (screen reader only) of the Change/Set button of the 'Mark the current episode as watched' row. Meaning: change this keyboard shortcut, which happens in the browser's own settings page. Length: medium.
settings.shortcut.manual: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Shortcuts (Chrome/Brave build), grey instruction under a row when the browser's shortcuts page couldn't be opened automatically. 'it' = the shortcut. Keep 'chrome://extensions/shortcuts' exactly. Informal you (FR tu, DE du). Length: medium, wraps.
settings.shortcut.manualFirefox: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Shortcuts (Firefox build), grey instruction when Firefox's shortcuts page couldn't be opened. 'it' = the shortcut. Keep 'about:addons' and '›'; use Firefox's own localized name of the gear-menu item 'Manage Extension Shortcuts'. Length: medium, wraps.
settings.shortcut.panelEditAria: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Shortcuts, aria-label (screen reader only) of the Change/Set button of the side panel row. Meaning: change the shortcut that opens/closes the side panel, in the browser's own settings page. Length: medium.
settings.shortcut.set: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Shortcuts, link-style button at the right of a row with no key; opens the browser's keyboard-shortcuts page. Meaning: assign a key (verb). Quoted in settings.shortcuts.help: keep identical. Length: short, ≤ 12 chars.
settings.shortcut.shiftKey: Where: inside displayed key combos (Settings (popup & side panel) › Shortcuts and home summary): replaces 'Shift' in 'Alt+Shift+K' → 'Alt+Maj+K'. Meaning: the Shift key's name as printed on keyboards in your language (FR 'Maj', DE 'Umschalt'); 'Alt' is never translated. Length: very short.
settings.shortcuts.episode: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Shortcuts, label of the 1st shortcut row (key shown below). Meaning: keyboard shortcut that marks the episode playing in the current tab as watched and syncs it right away. Mirrors the command name in the browser's shortcuts page: keep consistent. Length: medium.
settings.shortcuts.help: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Shortcuts, help paragraph under the card. Meaning: a key the user changed survives extension updates; if a key is missing or taken by the browser or another extension, assign one with the 'Change' / 'Set' buttons (quote settings.shortcut.edit / .set). Informal you (FR tu, DE du). Length: long.
settings.shortcuts.panel: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Shortcuts (Chrome/Brave build), label of the 2nd shortcut row. Meaning: shortcut that toggles SyncKai's side panel. Mirrors the command name in the browser's shortcuts page: keep consistent. Length: medium.
settings.shortcuts.panelFirefox: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Shortcuts (Firefox build), label of the 2nd shortcut row. Meaning: shortcut that shows or hides SyncKai's side panel (Firefox sidebar). Length: medium.
settings.shortcuts.pointer: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Playback & sync › Sync card, link-style row with a chevron at the bottom; opens the Settings › Shortcuts page. Meaning: keyboard shortcuts (noun). Length: short, ≤ 30 chars.
settings.shortcuts.unset: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Shortcuts, grey text shown instead of the key when the command has no key assigned. Meaning: no key set. Length: short, ≤ 16 chars.
settings.status.failed: Where: Settings (popup & side panel), top bar: red badge with a warning icon at the top-right, stays visible when a setting couldn't be saved. Meaning: saving failed (noun or adjective, e.g. FR « Échec »). Length: very short, ≤ 10 chars (overlays the page title).
settings.status.failedTitle: Where: Settings (popup & side panel), tooltip (title) of the red 'Failed' badge in the top bar. Meaning: the setting change wasn't saved; closing and reopening SyncKai (popup or side panel) reloads the settings. Informal you (FR tu, DE du). Length: short.
settings.status.saved: Where: Settings (popup & side panel), top bar: green badge with a check mark at the top-right, shown for 1.5 s after each change. Meaning: the setting was saved (past participle). Length: very short, ≤ 12 chars (overlays the page title).
settings.trigger.credits: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Sync, title of the 1st option card under « Episode counted as watched ». Meaning: an episode counts as watched when its end credits start. Changed 2026-10-17: « (recommended) » moved to settings.trigger.creditsHelp. Length: short, one line.
settings.trigger.legend: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Sync, bold legend above two option cards: « At the start of the credits » / « At a fixed percentage ». Meaning: the moment an episode counts as watched (and is synced). Changed 2026-10-17 (was « Episode watched »). Length: short, one line at 360 px.
settings.trigger.percentage: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Sync, title of the 2nd option card under « Episode counted as watched ». Meaning: an episode counts as watched once a set share of it has played (set with the 70–98 % slider below). Length: short, one line.
sync.alreadyCompleted: Where: per-service result in the in-page toast ('AniList · …') and popup details. Meaning: progress not changed because the series is already Completed in that list (SyncKai may then offer a rewatch). Length: short. Notes: reason fragment; first letter lowercased by code (not German); no final period.
sync.beyondEntry_one: Where: per-service result in the in-page toast ('MyAnimeList · …') and popup details. Meaning: not written: that service's entry has fewer episodes (seasons split differently). Placeholders: {progress} = episode, e.g. 13; {count} = the entry's episode count, e.g. 12 (plural variants; the English _one says "only episode" and omits {count}). Length: medium. Notes: fragment; first letter lowercased (not German).
sync.beyondEntry_other: Plural form of sync.beyondEntry_one (e.g. 'Episode 13 exceeds the entry's 12 episodes'). Same place: per-service result in the in-page toast and popup details. Placeholders: {progress} = episode; {count} = the entry's episode count. Notes: fragment; first letter lowercased (not German).
sync.correctionOutdated: Where: per-service result after confirming a correction (popup Activity › To check). Meaning: correction not applied because the list progress changed since the corrected sync. Placeholders: {progress} = current progress, e.g. 7. Length: long. Notes: fragment; first letter lowercased by code (not German); no final period.
sync.correctionPending: Where: reason in the in-page toast ('{reason}. Click the SyncKai icon…') and side panel status. Meaning: a correction is pending for this season; the episode is held and applied once the user decides on its card in the popup's Activity tab. Length: long. Notes: no final period; 'Activity' = tab name.
sync.correctionReason: Where: popup Activity › To check, reason line of a check card opened with 'Correct'. Meaning: correction requested; the series is currently synced to the entry {title}. Placeholders: {title} = AniList entry title, e.g. 'Frieren'. Length: medium. Notes: your language's quotation marks; no final period.
sync.invalidEpisode: Where: error on a popup Activity › To check card after confirming a choice. Meaning: the chosen episode number does not fit the chosen entry. Placeholders: {progress} = episode, e.g. 30; {title} = entry title; {total} = its episode count, or '?' if unknown. Length: medium. Notes: your language's quotation marks.
sync.noEquivalent: Where: per-service result in in-page toasts and popup/side panel details ('MyAnimeList: …'). Meaning: this service has no entry matching the AniList entry (e.g. no MyAnimeList ID), so nothing was written there. Length: short. Notes: fragment; first letter lowercased by code (not German); no period.
sync.noServiceFollows: Where: error in the popup/side panel or in-page toasts (rating, rewatch, comment, status, +1/−1, remove). Meaning: none of the connected services (AniList/MyAnimeList) has an entry (the anime’s page on that service) for this series, so nothing can be written; e.g. only MyAnimeList is connected and the AniList entry has no MyAnimeList ID. Not about the user’s list (the series may simply not be in it: that is another message). Say “has an entry/page”, never “tracks” or “follows”. Length: medium.
sync.recentNotFound: Where: error in popup Activity › Recent syncs after clicking 'Correct'. Meaning: that recent sync no longer exists. Length: short. Notes: 'Sync' = noun.
sync.review.burst: Where: reason shown on a « To check » card (popup and side panel Activity › To check, in-page toast after a sync). Meaning: more than five episodes were reported as finished within ten minutes (same tab or same series), which looks like a page script rather than the user watching; nothing was written, the card lets the user confirm. Length: medium. Notes: fragment ending with ': to check' like 'match.otherSeriesExcluded' (same term); no final period.
sync.review.finaleJump: Where: reason shown on a « To check » card (popup and side panel Activity › To check) and as a per-service result ('AniList: …'). Meaning: the sync would mark the series completed by jumping from episode {from} (0 = not in the list) straight to the last episode {progress}; nothing was written to that service, the user confirms on the card. Placeholders: {progress} = last episode number, {from} = current progress. Length: medium. Notes: fragment ending with ': to check' like 'match.otherSeriesExcluded'; no final period.
sync.reviewGone: Where: error in popup Activity › To check after confirming a card. Meaning: the check card no longer exists (already handled). 'Review' = a verification/check card (FR « vérification »), NOT a written review or critique. Length: short.
sync.sessionClosed: Where: per-service result in in-page toasts and popup details ('AniList: …'). Meaning: the account was signed out (or replaced by another) since the action started, so nothing was written to it. Length: medium. Notes: fragment; first letter lowercased by code (not German); no final period.
sync.seriesFallback: Where: used as the series title in popup/side panel results when the real title is unknown, e.g. '{title}: on hold'. Meaning: generic noun 'series' (an anime series). Length: short (one word). Notes: capitalized, singular.
time.countdown.days: Where: badge 'Ep. {episode} in {delay}' (popup Watching tab, 'On this page' card, side panel). Meaning: time until the next episode airs, in days. Placeholders: {count} = days (≥ 1). Length: very short. Notes: abbreviated unit ('d'); not pluralized: same form for every count.
time.countdown.hours: Where: badge 'Ep. {episode} in {delay}' (popup Watching tab, 'On this page' card, side panel), and the signed delay {offset} of the Schedule tooltips (agenda.estimate.title, agenda.estimate.custom). Meaning: a duration in hours (time until the next episode airs, or delay after the Japanese broadcast). Placeholders: {count} = 1–23 in the badge; in a delay, a signed number ('+1', '-2', up to '+168'), followed when needed by time.countdown.minutes ('+1 h 30 min'). Length: very short. Notes: abbreviated unit ('h'); not pluralized: same form for every count; keep {count} next to the unit so that a sign reads correctly.
time.countdown.minutes: Where: badge 'Ep. {episode} in {delay}' (popup Watching tab, 'On this page' card, side panel), and the signed delay {offset} of the Schedule tooltips (agenda.estimate.title, agenda.estimate.custom). Meaning: a duration in minutes (time until the next episode airs, or delay after the Japanese broadcast). Placeholders: {count} = 1–59 in the badge; in a delay, a signed number ('+45', '-30'), or the minutes after the hours without a sign ('+1 h 30 min'). Length: very short. Notes: abbreviated unit ('min'); not pluralized: same form for every count; keep {count} next to the unit so that a sign reads correctly.
time.daysAgo_one: Where: relative time, alone or as {relative} in 'Everything is synced · …', 'Last checked: …', 'Completed …', 'Analyzed …' (popup, settings). Meaning: N days ago (2 or more; 1 day uses time.yesterday). Placeholders: {count} = number of days. Length: short. Notes: plural form chosen by the number; lowercase start.
time.daysAgo_other: Plural form of time.daysAgo_one: relative time 'N days ago' (2 or more), alone or as {relative} inside other strings. Placeholders: {count} = number of days. Length: short. Notes: lowercase start; must read naturally after 'Completed' / 'Analyzed'.
time.hoursAgo: Where: relative time, alone or as {relative} in 'Everything is synced · …', 'Last checked: …', 'Completed …', 'Analyzed …' (popup, settings). Placeholders: {count} = 1–23. Length: short. Notes: not pluralized: keep the abbreviation ('h'); lowercase start.
time.justNow: Where: relative time (< 1 minute), alone or as {relative} in 'Everything is synced · …', 'Last checked: …', 'Completed …', 'Analyzed …'. Meaning: a moment ago. Length: short. Notes: lowercase start; must read naturally after 'Completed' / 'Analyzed'.
time.minutesAgo: Where: relative time, alone or as {relative} in 'Everything is synced · …', 'Last checked: …', 'Completed …', 'Analyzed …'. Placeholders: {count} = 1–59. Length: short. Notes: not pluralized: keep the abbreviation ('min'); lowercase start.
time.yesterday: Where: relative time (24–48 h ago), alone or as {relative} in 'Everything is synced · …', 'Last checked: …', 'Completed …', 'Analyzed …'. Length: short. Notes: lowercase start; must read naturally after 'Completed' / 'Analyzed'.
toast.line.saved: Where: in-page toast bubble on the streaming site, per-service line after a rating or rewatch ('AniList · saved'). Meaning: the rating/rewatch was saved on that service. Length: very short. Notes: lowercase fragment, no final period.
toast.pill.alreadyUpToDate: Where: in-page success toast (small pill, 3 s) on the streaming site, followed by ' · {series title}'. Meaning: the list was already up to date, nothing written (episode number unknown). Length: short (≈ 25 chars, never truncated).
toast.pill.saved: Where: in-page success toast (small pill, 3 s, 'Discreet' level) on the streaming site, followed by ' · {series title}'. Meaning: the watched episode was saved to the list. Placeholders: {episode} = episode number, e.g. 5. Length: short (≈ 25 chars, never truncated). Notes: 'Ep.' = episode abbreviation.
toast.pill.upToDate: Where: in-page success toast (small pill, 3 s) on the streaming site, followed by ' · {series title}'. Meaning: nothing written: the list already had this episode (or a later one). Placeholders: {episode} = progress already in the list, e.g. 5. Length: short (≈ 30 chars, never truncated).
watching.allWatched: Where: tooltip and screen-reader name of the disabled '+' button (popup › Watching rows and Continue card, 'On this page' card, side panel › Now playing). Meaning: every episode is already marked as watched. Length: medium.
watching.badge.available: Where: green chip on a series row (popup › Watching) and in the 'On this page' card / side panel. Meaning: the next episode to watch is already released. Placeholders: {episode} = that episode number, e.g. 3. Length: short (chip, ≤ ~22 chars). Notes: 'Ep.' abbreviation expected.
watching.badge.finished: Where: grey chip on a series row (popup › Watching) and in the 'On this page' card / side panel. Meaning: the anime finished airing (or was cancelled): no episode to wait for. NOT the user's 'Completed' status. Length: short (chip).
watching.badge.soon: Where: chip on a series row (popup › Watching) and in the 'On this page' card / side panel. Meaning: the anime is airing but the next episode's date isn't known. Length: short (chip, ≤ ~22 chars).
watching.badge.unknown: Where: grey chip on a series row (popup › Watching) and in the 'On this page' card / side panel. Meaning: no known date for the next episode. Length: short (chip).
watching.badge.upcoming: Where: chip on a series row (popup › Watching), 'On this page' card, side panel. Meaning: countdown to the next episode. Placeholders: {episode} = episode number, e.g. 5 (up to 4 digits: One Piece 1123); {delay} = translated compact countdown, e.g. '18 h', '2 d', '12 min'. Length: short (chip, ≤ ~22 chars); in a narrow Watching row the end of the chip is cut (full text in its tooltip), so put {episode} early. Notes: 'Ep.' abbreviation; reads 'Ep. 5 in 18 h'.
watching.confirm.COMPLETED: Where: inline confirmation (row '…' menu in popup › Watching; status row of 'On this page'/side panel), followed by Yes / No buttons. Meaning: confirm marking the series Completed. Length: short (~14 chars). Notes: question; keep '?' with locale spacing.
watching.confirm.DROPPED: Where: same inline confirmation, followed by Yes / No. Meaning: confirm setting the series to Dropped (abandoning it). Length: short (~14 chars). Notes: question; must not read as 'Cancel?'.
watching.confirm.no: Where: small button of the inline status confirmation. Meaning: No, keep the current status. Length: very short.
watching.confirm.noAria: Where: aria-label (screen readers) of that 'No' button. Meaning: cancel this status change. Placeholders: {action} = translated action label (watching.status.*), e.g. 'Drop' or 'Mark as completed'. Length: medium.
watching.confirm.yes: Where: small coloured button of the inline status confirmation. Meaning: Yes, apply the status. Length: very short.
watching.confirm.yesAria: Where: aria-label (screen readers) of that 'Yes' button. Meaning: confirm this status change. Placeholders: {action} = translated action label (watching.status.*), e.g. 'Drop' or 'Mark as completed'. Length: medium.
watching.empty.text: Where: popup › Watching empty state, text under 'Nothing in progress yet'. Meaning: watch an episode on a supported site; the series then appears here with its next episode's date. Length: long (wraps). Notes: 'it' = the series; Crunchyroll, ADN are names; informal imperative.
watching.empty.textPlatforms: Where: same as watching.empty.text, when Netflix/Disney+ access is enabled. Placeholders: {platforms} = locale-formatted 'or' list, e.g. 'Crunchyroll, ADN or Netflix'. Length: long (wraps). Notes: 'it' = the series; informal imperative.
watching.empty.title: Where: heading of the popup › Watching empty state. Meaning: no series in progress in your list yet. Length: short-medium.
watching.heroProgress: Where: series rows of popup › Watching (left of the − / + buttons), Continue card line, between −1/+1 in 'On this page'/side panel, per-list lines ('Watching · Ep. 5 / 12'). Placeholders: {progress} = episodes watched, e.g. 5; {total} = total episodes, e.g. 12. Length: short. Notes: 'Ep.' abbreviation expected.
watching.heroProgressNoTotal: Where: same as watching.heroProgress, when the total episode count is unknown. Placeholders: {progress} = episodes watched, e.g. 5. Length: short. Notes: 'Ep.' abbreviation expected.
watching.listAria: Where: aria-label (screen readers) of the series list in popup › Watching. Placeholders: {service} = 'AniList' or 'MyAnimeList'; {sort} = translated fragment such as 'by next release' (watching.sortAria.*). Length: medium.
watching.loading: Where: aria-label (screen readers) of the loading placeholder in popup › Watching. Meaning: your series list is loading. Length: short.
watching.menu.openEntry: Where: popup › Watching, series row '…' menu and the 'Continue' card menu: item that opens a sub-menu listing AniList / MyAnimeList (one per connected account). Meaning: open the anime's page (entry, FR « fiche ») on a tracking site; the sub-menu items are the bare service names. No placeholder. Length: short (menu item, ≤ 200 px with icon and chevron).
watching.menu.searchOn: Where: same '…' menu: item that opens a sub-menu listing streaming platforms (Crunchyroll, ADN) where the series has no known link. Meaning: search the series on one of those platforms; the sub-menu items are the bare platform names. Ends with '…' because the choice follows in the sub-menu. No placeholder. Length: short.
watching.menuAria: Where: aria-label (screen readers) of a series' '…' actions menu (popup › Watching rows; side panel › Now playing « Your list »). Placeholders: {title} = series title. Length: short.
watching.minusOne: Where: menu item in a row's '…' menu (popup › Watching); tooltip of the '−1' button ('On this page' card, side panel). Meaning: un-mark the last watched episode (progress −1). Length: short. Notes: keep '−1' with the minus sign.
watching.moreActions: Where: aria-label (screen readers) of the '…' button on series rows (popup › Watching) and in side panel › Now playing. Meaning: open the actions menu. Placeholders: {title} = series title. Length: medium.
watching.mySeries: Where: section heading above the series list in popup › Watching. Meaning: the user's series in progress. Length: short (shares the line with the sort and AniList/MAL controls).
watching.noOther: Where: popup › Watching, under 'My series' when the only series is shown in the Continue card above. Meaning: no other series in progress. Length: medium.
watching.openOn: Where: pill link in the Continue card and tooltip of the round platform-logo 'Open' button on series rows (popup › Watching). Meaning: open the series on the streaming platform. Placeholders: {platform} = 'Crunchyroll', 'ADN', 'Netflix', 'Disney+' or 'Prime Video'. Length: short (~20 chars incl. name).
watching.openOnAria: Where: aria-label (screen readers) of the platform links (Continue card pill and row screen icon, popup › Watching). Placeholders: {title} = series title; {platform} = streaming platform name, e.g. 'Crunchyroll'. Length: medium.
watching.searchOnAria: Where: aria-label (screen readers) of that search menu item. Placeholders: {title} = series title; {platform} = platform name, e.g. 'ADN'. Length: medium.
watching.openPlatform: Where: pill buttons in the popup › Watching empty state. Meaning: open the platform's home page. Placeholders: {platform} = 'Crunchyroll', 'ADN', 'Netflix' or 'Disney+'. Length: short.
watching.plusOneAria: Where: aria-label and tooltip of '+' buttons (popup › Watching rows and Continue card, 'On this page' card, side panel). Placeholders: {title} = series title. Length: medium.
watching.resume: Where: label (and aria-label) of the card at the top of popup › Watching showing the series to continue watching. Meaning: 'Continue watching' heading, not a button. Length: short.
watching.resumeSync: Where: green menu item in a row's '…' menu (popup › Watching) for an excluded series. Meaning: re-enable syncing for this series. Length: short-medium.
watching.seenOf_one: Where: screen-reader name of a series row's − / + group and of its cover progress bar (popup › Watching). Placeholders: {count} = episodes watched (the plural form follows {count}); {total} = total episodes. Length: medium.
watching.seenOf_other: Plural form of watching.seenOf_one (chosen by {count}), e.g. '5 of 12 episodes watched'. Placeholders: {count} = episodes watched; {total} = total. Notes: serves every count not in 'one'.
watching.seen_one: Where: screen-reader name of a series row's − / + group when the total is unknown (popup › Watching). Placeholders: {count} = episodes watched, e.g. 1. Length: short.
watching.seen_other: Plural form of watching.seen_one, e.g. '7 episodes watched'. Placeholders: {count} = episodes watched. Notes: serves every count not in 'one'.
watching.sort.nextEpisode: Where: sort menu item and visible label of the sort button (popup › Watching). Meaning: sort by next episode (available ones first, then soonest release). Length: short (~18 chars).
watching.sort.recent: Where: sort menu item and visible label of the sort button (popup › Watching). Meaning: most recently updated list entries first. Length: short (~18 chars).
watching.sort.remaining: Where: sort menu item and visible label of the sort button (popup › Watching). Meaning: series with the fewest episodes left to watch first. Length: short (~18 chars).
watching.sort.title: Where: sort menu item and visible label of the sort button (popup › Watching). Meaning: alphabetical by title. Length: short. Notes: keep '(A → Z)' or adapt to your script's first/last letters.
watching.sortAria.nextEpisode: Where: fragment inserted as {sort} in watching.listAria ('My AniList series, sorted by next release'), screen readers only. Meaning: sorted by next episode release. Length: short. Notes: lowercase sentence fragment.
watching.sortAria.recent: Where: fragment inserted as {sort} in watching.listAria, screen readers only. Meaning: sorted by last update of the list entry. Length: short. Notes: lowercase sentence fragment.
watching.sortAria.remaining: Where: fragment inserted as {sort} in watching.listAria, screen readers only. Meaning: sorted by number of episodes left. Length: short. Notes: lowercase sentence fragment.
watching.sortAria.title: Where: fragment inserted as {sort} in watching.listAria, screen readers only. Meaning: sorted alphabetically by title. Length: short. Notes: lowercase sentence fragment.
watching.sortMenu: Where: aria-label (screen readers) of the sort dropdown menu in popup › Watching. Meaning: sort my series. Length: short.
watching.sortTrigger: Where: aria-label (screen readers) of the sort button (popup › Watching). Placeholders: {label} = current sort option (watching.sort.*), e.g. 'Next release'. Length: short. Notes: verb prefix (FR 'Trier :', DE 'Sortieren:').
watching.status.COMPLETED: Where: menu item of a row's '…' menu (popup › Watching); tooltip/aria-label of the status button in 'On this page'/side panel; {action} in watching.confirm.*Aria. Meaning: set the list status to Completed. Length: short-medium. Notes: imperative.
watching.status.DROPPED: Where: same as watching.status.COMPLETED. Meaning: set the list status to Dropped, i.e. abandon the series. Length: short-medium. Notes: imperative; must not read as 'Cancel' (DE uses 'Serie abbrechen').
watching.status.PAUSED: Where: same as watching.status.COMPLETED. Meaning: set the list status to Paused (AniList) / On-Hold (MAL). Length: short-medium. Notes: imperative.
watching.tip: Where: popup welcome screen (last line) and 'Tip' card of the popup › Watching empty state. Meaning: Netflix, Disney+ and Prime Video support (opt-in) and the preferred platform used by 'Open' are set on the settings page {path}. Placeholders: {path} = clickable 'Settings › Platforms'. Length: long. Notes: keep {path} exactly once; 'player' = settings.player.label.
watching.tipTitle: Where: label of the tip card in the popup › Watching empty state (also its aria-label). Meaning: 'Tip' (hint). Length: very short.
settings.autoSync.helpOff: Where: Settings (popup & side panel), help under the 'Auto sync' toggle (Settings home › Quick settings, Sync) while it is off. Meaning: syncing is paused, no watched episode is sent to AniList/MyAnimeList. No final period. Length: medium.
settings.autoSync.helpOn: Where: Settings (popup & side panel), help under the 'Auto sync' toggle (Settings home › Quick settings, Sync) while it is on. Meaning: each episode the user finishes is sent automatically to AniList/MyAnimeList. No final period. Length: medium.
settings.backHomeAria: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) sub-pages, aria-label (screen reader only) of the top-left back button whose visible text is 'Settings'. Meaning: return to the Settings home (list of categories). Length: short.
settings.cat.data: Where: Settings (popup & side panel): title of a Settings home category row (summary '12 matches · 2 excluded') and of that sub-page (truncated in the top bar). Meaning: data stored by SyncKai (matches, excluded series, import, backup). First person 'My'. Length: short, ≤ 20 chars.
settings.cat.help: Where: Settings (popup & side panel): title of a Settings home category row (summary 'v2.3.1') and of that sub-page (truncated in the top bar). Meaning: help (diagnostics, problem report) and information about the extension. Length: short, ≤ 22 chars.
settings.cat.notifications: Where: Settings (popup & side panel): title of a Settings home category row (summary 'Discreet · alerts off') and of that sub-page (top bar). Meaning: on-page notifications and release alerts. Changed 2026-10-17: the Schedule options moved to the Platforms category, so the title is the single word. Length: short, ≤ 20 chars.
settings.cat.shortcuts: Where: Settings (popup & side panel): title of a Settings home category row (summary 'Alt+Shift+K · Alt+Shift+1') and of that sub-page. Meaning: keyboard shortcuts. Length: short, ≤ 20 chars.
settings.crImport.help: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data, import card, grey text under 'Catch up on what you’ve already watched' (settings.import.title). Meaning: the history can come from Crunchyroll, ADN or Netflix (the platform is chosen on the import page); a preview is shown before anything is written to AniList / MyAnimeList. Changed 2026-10-17: two sentences, final period. Informal you. Length: medium, wraps.
settings.group.more: Where: Settings (popup & side panel), Settings home: section heading above the rows My data, Language, Help & about (CSS uppercases it: write normal case). Meaning: data and help. Length: short, ≤ 24 chars.
settings.group.quick: Where: Settings (popup & side panel), Settings home: first section heading, above the two most-used toggles (Auto sync, Release alerts); CSS uppercases it, write normal case. Meaning: quick-access settings. Length: short, ≤ 24 chars.
settings.help.journal: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Help & about › Help card, bold row title (list icon); the count of recorded errors is under it, an unfold chevron and a red 'Clear' button on the right. Meaning: the local error log (list of recorded errors). Also the screen-reader name of the unfold button. Length: short.
settings.mappings.resetHelp: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Sync › Matches page, Danger zone, help text in the 'Matches' row above 'Reset all'. Meaning: deletes every remembered match; each one is worked out again the next time an episode is watched. Length: medium, wraps.
settings.panel.defaultTab: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Playback & sync › Side panel card, row label left of a 3-option control (Last opened | Now playing | Schedule). Meaning: which side-panel tab shows when the panel opens. Length: short, ≤ 20 chars.
settings.panel.live.help: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Playback & sync › Side panel card, help under 'Show live progress'. Meaning: the 'Now playing' tab shows the playback position and a countdown to the sync; quote that tab's translation (panel.tab.nowPlaying). No final period. Length: medium.
settings.panel.live.label: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Playback & sync › Side panel card, toggle label. Meaning: display the episode's playback progress in real time in the side panel. Length: short, ≤ 28 chars.
settings.panel.tab.last: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Playback & sync › Side panel, 1st option of a 3-button segmented control (Last opened | Now playing | Schedule). Meaning: reopen whichever tab was open last time. Length: very short, ≤ 12 chars (3 buttons share ~300 px).
settings.quick.airing.help: Where: Settings (popup & side panel): grey description under « Release alerts » on the Settings home › Quick settings and in Settings › Notifications › New episodes (hidden in the 320 px side panel). Meaning: a browser notification when an episode of a series you watch is out. Informal you. Length: one line.
settings.quick.airing.label: Where: Settings (popup & side panel): toggle label on the Settings home › Quick settings, and the same toggle in Settings › Notifications › New episodes. Meaning: alerts about new episode releases (noun phrase). Length: short, ≤ 22 chars.
settings.section.danger: Where: Settings (popup & side panel), bottom of Sync › Matches and of Help & about: red section heading (CSS uppercases it) above irreversible actions (Reset all, Clear log). Meaning: the conventional 'danger zone'. Length: short.
settings.section.panel: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Playback & sync, section heading above the side-panel options (CSS uppercases it: write normal case). Meaning: SyncKai's side panel (Firefox: sidebar). Length: short.
settings.summary.airingDelay: Where: Settings (popup & side panel), Settings home, summary of the Notifications & schedule row after '<level> · ', e.g. 'Discreet · alerts +3 h'. Placeholders: {hours} = 1, 3 or 6. Meaning: release alerts come {hours} hours after the Japanese airing. Lowercase fragment (except DE nouns); truncated line, keep short.
settings.summary.airingOff: Where: Settings (popup & side panel), Settings home, summary of the Notifications & schedule row after '<level> · ', e.g. 'Discreet · alerts off'. Meaning: new-episode release alerts are turned off. Lowercase fragment; truncated line, keep short.
settings.summary.airingOnTime: Where: Settings (popup & side panel), Settings home, summary of the Notifications & schedule row after '<level> · ', e.g. 'Discreet · alerts on time'. Meaning: release alerts are on, sent right at the Japanese airing time (no delay). Lowercase fragment; keep short.
settings.summary.connected: Where: Settings (popup & side panel), Settings home, Accounts card summary after a coloured dot, e.g. 'AniList connected · MAL: session expired' or 'AniList connected · MAL not connected'. Placeholders: {service} = 'AniList' or 'MAL'. Meaning: this account is connected. Changed 2026-10-17: the ✓ became a word. Notes: the adjective may agree with 'account' (FR « compte » masculine). Length: very short.
settings.summary.credits: Where: Settings (popup & side panel), Settings home, summary of the Playback & sync row after '<preferred platform> · ', e.g. 'Crunchyroll · at the credits'. Meaning: episodes count as watched when the end credits start. Lowercase fragment; keep short (truncated line).
settings.summary.errors_one: Where: Settings (popup & side panel), Settings home, Help & about row summary, before ' · v2.3.1'. Placeholders: {count} = number of errors in the local error log (≥ 1). Length: very short. Keep {count} as digits: in some languages the 'one' form also covers 0 or 21, 31…
settings.summary.errors_other: Plural form of settings.summary.errors_one (e.g. '3 errors · v2.3.1'), Settings home summary.
settings.summary.expired: Where: Settings (popup & side panel), Settings home, Accounts row summary in red, e.g. 'MAL: session expired'. Placeholders: {service} = 'AniList' or 'MAL'. Meaning: the sign-in expired; the user must reconnect. Length: short.
settings.summary.languageAuto: Where: Settings (popup & side panel), Settings home, Language row summary when the language follows the browser. Placeholders: {language} = name of the active language in that language (endonym), e.g. 'English', 'Deutsch'. Notes: same word as settings.language.auto. Length: short.
settings.summary.loading: Where: Settings (popup & side panel): Settings home row summaries, the Matches card and the Shortcuts rows while data is read. Meaning: loading in progress. Ends with an ellipsis (…). Length: short.
settings.summary.noAccount: Where: Settings (popup & side panel), Settings home, Accounts row summary when neither AniList nor MyAnimeList is connected. Length: short, ≤ 30 chars (truncated line).
settings.summary.paused: Where: Settings (popup & side panel), Settings home, the whole Sync row summary when automatic sync is off. Meaning: automatic sync is paused, no episode is sent. Changed 2026-10-17: now a standalone summary, capitalised. Length: very short.
settings.summary.percentage: Where: Settings (popup & side panel), Settings home, summary of the Playback & sync row after '<preferred platform> · ', e.g. 'ADN · at 85%'. Placeholders: {percent} = value formatted by settings.percent, e.g. '85%'. Meaning: episodes count as watched at that point. Lowercase fragment.
settings.summary.version: Where: Settings (popup & side panel), Settings home, 'Help & about' row summary ('Version 2.4.0 · no errors'), and Help & about › About card, line under 'SyncKai'. Placeholders: {version} = '2.4.0'. Length: short.
settings.cat.platforms: Where: Settings (popup & side panel): title of a Settings home category row (summary '4 of 5 active · Crunchyroll player') and of that sub-page (top bar); also quoted in the path 'Settings › Platforms' of other texts (panel.offTargetEnable, popup empty state). Meaning: the streaming sites SyncKai follows (Crunchyroll, ADN, Netflix, Disney+, Prime Video): access, preferred player, estimated release time. Length: short, ≤ 20 chars.
settings.cat.display: Where: Settings (popup & side panel): title of a Settings home category row (summary 'Language, side panel, keyboard shortcuts') and of that sub-page (top bar, and back button of its sub-pages Language and Shortcuts). Meaning: how SyncKai looks and is used: interface language, side panel options, keyboard shortcuts. Length: short, ≤ 20 chars.
settings.backToAria: Where: Settings (popup & side panel), screen-reader label of the back button at the top left of a second-level settings page (its visible text is only the parent page's title, e.g. '← Display'). Placeholders: {page} = title of the parent page, e.g. 'Display' (settings.cat.display). Meaning: go back to that page. Length: short (not shown).
settings.group.categories: Where: Settings (popup & side panel), Settings home, screen-reader name of the card listing Sync, Platforms, Notifications and Display (not shown). Meaning: the settings categories. Length: short.
settings.summary.notConnected: Where: Settings (popup & side panel), Settings home, Accounts card summary, after the other account's state, e.g. 'AniList connected · MAL not connected'. Placeholders: {service} = 'AniList' or 'MAL'. Meaning: the user has not connected this account. Same form as settings.summary.connected. Length: very short.
settings.summary.bothConnected: Where: Settings (popup & side panel), Settings home, Accounts card summary after a green dot, when both accounts are connected. Meaning: both accounts are connected to SyncKai. Keep the service names as is. Length: short (one line at 400 px, may wrap in the 320 px side panel).
settings.summary.auto: Where: Settings (popup & side panel), Settings home, start of the Sync row summary, e.g. 'Auto · at the credits'. Meaning: automatic sync is on (the opposite summary is settings.summary.paused). Capitalised: it starts the line. Length: very short.
settings.summary.platforms_one: Where: Settings (popup & side panel), Settings home, Platforms row summary before ' · <player>', e.g. '4 of 5 active · Crunchyroll player'. Placeholders: {count} = streaming platforms SyncKai follows (Crunchyroll and ADN always, plus Netflix / Disney+ / Prime Video when their access is on); {total} = 5. Meaning: how many of the supported platforms are on. 'active' agrees with 'platforms' (FR « plateformes », feminine plural). Length: short.
settings.summary.platforms_other: Plural form of settings.summary.platforms_one (e.g. '4 of 5 active'), Settings home summary.
settings.summary.player: Where: Settings (popup & side panel), Settings home, end of the Platforms row summary after '4 of 5 active · '. Placeholders: {player} = platform name (Crunchyroll, ADN, Netflix, Prime Video). Meaning: the preferred player, the site the « Open » buttons use (settings.player.label). Lowercase fragment (except DE nouns). Length: short.
settings.summary.display: Where: Settings (popup & side panel), Settings home, fixed summary of the Display row. Meaning: what the Display page holds (interface language, side panel options, keyboard shortcuts). Use the same words as settings.section.language, settings.section.panel and settings.shortcuts.pointer. Length: one line at 400 px (≤ 45 chars), hidden in the 320 px side panel.
settings.summary.data: Where: Settings (popup & side panel), Settings home, fixed summary of the My data row. Meaning: what the My data page holds: importing a viewing history from a streaming site, and the backup (export / import of SyncKai data). Use the words of the history import and backup pages. Keep « · ». Length: one line at 400 px (≤ 45 chars).
settings.summary.noErrors: Where: Settings (popup & side panel), Settings home, Help & about row summary after 'Version 2.4.0 · '. Meaning: the local error log is empty (otherwise settings.summary.errors, '2 errors'). Lowercase fragment. Length: very short.
settings.display.keyboard: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Display, uppercase section title above the « Keyboard shortcuts » row. Meaning: keyboard-related settings. Length: short.
settings.display.shortcutsHelp: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Display, grey description under the « Keyboard shortcuts » row (opens the Shortcuts page). Meaning: what the shortcuts do: mark the episode playing as watched (settings.shortcuts.episode), open or close the side panel. Length: one line at 400 px (≤ 50 chars), hidden in the 320 px side panel.
settings.shortcuts.duringPlayback: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Display › Shortcuts, uppercase section title above the « Confirm the episode playing » shortcut card. Meaning: shortcut used while watching an episode. Length: short.
settings.shortcuts.navigation: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Display › Shortcuts, uppercase section title above the « Open or close the side panel » shortcut card. Meaning: shortcut that moves around the extension (opens the side panel). Length: short.
settings.accounts.lists: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Accounts, uppercase section title above the AniList and MyAnimeList account cards. Meaning: the anime lists SyncKai keeps up to date. Length: short.
settings.accounts.both: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Accounts, uppercase section title above the « Default entry page » choice. Meaning: options that only apply when both AniList and MyAnimeList are connected. Length: short.
settings.accounts.privacy: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Accounts, grey note at the bottom of the page. Meaning: « Connect » opens the official sign-in page of the service; the password is typed there, never in SyncKai. Informal « tu » register. Length: one or two lines.
settings.account.expiredHelp: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Accounts, grey text inside the card of an account whose session expired, under « Session expired » and the « Reconnect » button. Placeholders: {service} = AniList or MyAnimeList. Meaning: syncs to that service are stopped until the user reconnects. May be followed by settings.account.otherStillSynced (joined as two sentences). Length: one or two lines.
settings.account.otherStillSynced: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Accounts, second sentence after settings.account.expiredHelp, only when the other account is still connected, e.g. 'Your episodes are no longer sent to MyAnimeList until you reconnect. AniList is still updated.' Placeholders: {service} = the other service, AniList or MyAnimeList. Meaning: syncs to that other service go on. Length: short.
settings.entry.unavailable: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Accounts, note with an info icon under the « Default entry page » choice, shown while it is disabled (only one account, or none, connected). Meaning: the choice works only with both accounts connected. Length: one or two lines.
settings.section.automatic: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Sync, section heading above « Auto sync », the « Episode counted as watched » choice and the percentage slider (CSS uppercases it: write normal case). Meaning: automatic synchronization settings (adjective used as a heading). Length: short, ≤ 20 chars.
settings.section.perSeries: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Sync, section heading above the « Remembered matches » and « Excluded series » rows (CSS uppercases it: write normal case). Meaning: settings that apply series by series. Length: short, ≤ 20 chars.
settings.trigger.creditsHelp: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Sync, grey description under « At the start of the credits ». Meaning: recommended option; the platform tells SyncKai exactly when the credits start. No final period. Length: one or two lines.
settings.trigger.percentageHelp: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Sync, grey description under « At a fixed percentage ». Meaning: the percentage is also the fallback when the credits are unknown (even with the credits option). No final period. Length: one or two lines.
settings.sync.mappingsRow: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Sync › Per series, row that opens the Matches page (count at its right). Meaning: the remembered links between a platform season and an AniList entry (same word as settings.section.mappings). Length: short, ≤ 30 chars.
settings.sync.mappingsRowHelp: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Sync › Per series, grey description under « Remembered matches » (hidden in the 320 px side panel). Meaning: for each series, the AniList season (entry) SyncKai writes to. No final period. Length: one line.
settings.sync.exclusionsRowHelp: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Sync › Per series, grey description under « Excluded series » (hidden in the 320 px side panel). Meaning: these series are never synced; they can be re-enabled on that page. No final period. Length: one line.
settings.mappings.intro_one: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Sync › Matches, grey paragraph under the search field. Placeholders: {count} = number of remembered matches. Meaning: the matches are grouped by platform; each links a platform season (→) to the AniList entry SyncKai writes to; forgetting one makes SyncKai work it out again at the next episode. Keep « → ». Plural forms: give every form your language needs. Length: two or three lines.
settings.mappings.intro_other: Plural form of settings.mappings.intro_one (e.g. « 73 series remembered, grouped by platform: … »).
settings.mappings.search: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Sync › Matches, placeholder and screen-reader name of the search field. Meaning: filter the matches by series title or AniList entry title. Length: short, ≤ 36 chars.
settings.mappings.noResult: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Sync › Matches, bold text in a dashed card when the search finds nothing. Placeholders: {query} = what the user typed. Use your language’s quotation marks. Length: one line.
settings.mappings.noResultHelp: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Sync › Matches, grey hint under settings.mappings.noResult. Meaning: the search looks at series titles and AniList entry titles. Ends with a period. Length: one line.
settings.mappings.emptyHelp: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Sync › Matches, grey hint under « No matches yet » in a dashed card. Meaning: SyncKai remembers one match for each season it syncs. Ends with a period. Length: one line.
settings.mappings.showMore_one: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Sync › Matches, button at the bottom of a platform card that shows its other matches (the card shows 4 first). Placeholders: {count} = number of hidden matches; {platform} = Crunchyroll, ADN, Netflix, Disney+ or Prime Video. Opposite: settings.mappings.hide. Plural forms: give every form your language needs. Length: one line.
settings.mappings.showMore_other: Plural form of settings.mappings.showMore_one (e.g. « Show 57 more on Crunchyroll »).
settings.mappings.origin.chosen: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Sync › Matches, green badge on a match and in the legend. Meaning: the user picked or confirmed this match (season picker, « To check » card). Agrees with « match » (FR « Choisie »). Length: short badge, ≤ 18 chars.
settings.mappings.origin.learned: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Sync › Matches, lavender badge on a match and in the legend. Meaning: SyncKai found this match by itself. Agrees with « match ». Length: short badge, ≤ 14 chars.
settings.mappings.origin.unmarked: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Sync › Matches, grey badge on a match and in the legend. Meaning: saved by an older SyncKai (before 2.4), origin unknown. Agrees with « match ». Length: short badge, ≤ 14 chars.
settings.mappings.origin.unverified: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Sync › Matches, yellow badge on a match and in the legend. Meaning: restored from a backup and not checked again yet. Keep « · ». Length: badge, ≤ 28 chars.
settings.mappings.origin.chosenHelp: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Sync › Matches, legend (dashed card), text next to the « Chosen by you » badge. Meaning: confirmed or chosen by the user, never questioned by SyncKai. Ends with a period. Length: one or two lines.
settings.mappings.origin.learnedHelp: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Sync › Matches, legend, text next to the « Learned » badge. Meaning: found by SyncKai; worked out again when the platform’s data contradicts it. Ends with a period. Length: one or two lines.
settings.mappings.origin.unmarkedHelp: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Sync › Matches, legend, text next to the « Legacy » badge. Meaning: saved before version 2.4; kept, but sent to « To check » when contradicted. Ends with a period. Length: one or two lines.
settings.mappings.origin.unverifiedHelp: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Sync › Matches, legend, text next to the « Imported · to recheck » badge. Meaning: restored from a SyncKai backup; checked again against AniList the first time it is used. Ends with a period. Length: one or two lines.
settings.mappings.originLegend: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Sync › Matches, screen-reader name of the legend that explains the four origin badges. Length: short (not shown).
settings.exclusions.section: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Sync › Excluded series, section heading above the list (CSS uppercases it: write normal case), with the count at its right. Meaning: series that are never synced. Agrees with « series ». Length: short, ≤ 24 chars.
settings.exclusions.help: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Sync › Excluded series, grey note under the list. Placeholders: {action} = the « Re-enable » button label (settings.exclusions.reactivate). Meaning: an excluded series is never synced, whatever the season; « Re-enable » tracks it again from the next episode. Use your language’s quotation marks. Length: two lines.
settings.exclusions.emptyHelp: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Sync › Excluded series, grey hint under « No excluded series. » in a dashed card. Placeholders: {action} = the menu item « Stop syncing this series » (common.stopSyncSeries). Meaning: how to exclude a series (from its « ⋯ » menu). Keep « ⋯ ». Length: two lines.
settings.exclusions.seriesYear: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Sync › Excluded series, grey line under a series title, between « · » (« Prime Video · 1997 series · excluded on Oct 3 »). Placeholders: {year} = start year of the series, e.g. 1997 (tells remakes apart). Lowercase fragment. Length: short.
settings.exclusions.excludedOn: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Sync › Excluded series, last fragment of the grey line under a series title (« Netflix · excluded on Sep 12 »). Placeholders: {date} = day and short month, formatted for your locale (with the year when it is not the current one). Lowercase fragment. Length: short.
settings.platforms.where: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Platforms, section heading above the list of streaming sites (Crunchyroll, ADN, Netflix, Disney+, Prime Video) with their « Included » label or on / off switch (CSS uppercases it: write normal case). Meaning: the sites on which SyncKai detects the episodes you watch. Informal you (FR tu, DE du). Length: one line at 320 px, ≤ 36 chars.
settings.platforms.allAnime: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Platforms, grey description under « Crunchyroll » and « ADN » in the list of sites. Meaning: on these two sites every anime is synced (unlike Netflix / Disney+, where only anime linked on AniList are). Length: short, one line.
settings.platforms.included: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Platforms, green label at the right of the Crunchyroll and ADN rows, where Netflix / Disney+ / Prime Video have an on / off switch. Meaning: these sites are always on, part of the extension (no access to turn on). Length: very short, ≤ 12 chars.
settings.platforms.accessMissing: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Platforms, yellow label at the right of the Crunchyroll and ADN rows (in place of « Included ») when the browser no longer gives SyncKai access to these sites (Firefox lets the user remove it); a banner « SyncKai can’t access Crunchyroll / ADN » + « Allow access » shows above. Length: very short, ≤ 16 chars.
settings.platforms.note: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Platforms, grey note under the list of sites. Meaning: turning on Netflix, Disney+ or Prime Video makes the browser ask for access to that site; SyncKai reads only the playback and series pages there. Length: two lines.
settings.player.openOn: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Platforms › Preferred player, label of the row-wide button that opens the list of platforms (the chosen platform's logo and name follow it on the right, e.g. « Open episodes on   [logo] Crunchyroll ⌄ »). Meaning: the « Open » buttons open the episode on this site. Length: short, ≤ 26 chars.
settings.player.enableFirst: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Platforms › Preferred player, yellow hint at the right of a greyed-out option (Netflix or Prime Video) in the dropdown list, when that platform is not turned on above. Meaning: turn this platform on first (in the list above) to choose it. Infinitive or short imperative. Length: very short, ≤ 16 chars.
settings.offsets.earlier: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Platforms › Estimated release time, tooltip and screen-reader name of the « − » button of a platform row. Placeholders: {minutes} = 15. Meaning: lower that platform's delay by 15 minutes (episodes expected earlier). « min » = minutes, abbreviated as in settings.offsets.unit. Length: short.
settings.offsets.later: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Platforms › Estimated release time, tooltip and screen-reader name of the « + » button of a platform row. Placeholders: {minutes} = 15. Meaning: raise that platform's delay by 15 minutes (episodes expected later). « min » as in settings.offsets.unit. Length: short.
settings.notif.legend: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Notifications, screen-reader name of the group of three style cards (not shown). Meaning: the style of the messages SyncKai shows on the playback page. Length: short.
settings.import.title: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data, bold title of the import card (download icon), above settings.crImport.help and the 'Import a watch history' button. Meaning: bring AniList / MyAnimeList up to date with episodes the user already watched on a streaming site. Informal you (FR tu, DE du). No final period. Length: medium, wraps.
settings.section.compare: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data, section heading above the 'AniList ↔ MyAnimeList differences' row (CSS uppercases it: write normal case). Meaning: comparing the user's AniList and MyAnimeList lists. Length: short, one word if possible.
settings.compare.title: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data, bold title of the row that opens the comparison page (a yellow count of differences may follow); also the bold title of the same row in the popup's Activity screen. Meaning: differences between the user's AniList list and their MyAnimeList list. Notes: keep '↔' and both service names. Length: medium, wraps on two lines in a narrow panel.
settings.compare.help: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data, grey description under 'AniList ↔ MyAnimeList differences' (hidden in a side panel narrower than ~340 px); also under the same row in the popup's Activity screen. Meaning: the page compares both lists and lets the user copy one onto the other, in the direction they choose. No final period. Length: medium, wraps.
settings.data.perSeries: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data, grey note at the bottom of the page. Placeholders: {path} = where those settings now live, built from this catalog's titles: settings.section.sync › settings.section.perSeries (FR « Synchronisation › Par série »). Meaning: matches (remembered season → AniList entry) and excluded series are no longer on this page; they are managed in that place. Length: medium, wraps.
compare.align: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › AniList ↔ MAL differences, section heading above the filter chips and the bulk buttons (CSS uppercases it: write normal case). Meaning: verb, make both lists identical by copying one service's values onto the other. Same verb as compare.bulk.* ('Align everything with AniList'). Length: very short.
compare.bulk.help: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › AniList ↔ MAL differences, grey note under the two bulk buttons. Placeholders: {action} = the label of the first bulk button (compare.bulk.anilist, e.g. 'Align everything with AniList'), keep the quotes of your language around it. Meaning: that button copies the AniList values onto MyAnimeList (never the reverse); before anything is written, a confirmation lists the changes. Length: long, wraps.
compare.job.background: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › AniList ↔ MAL differences, grey line at the bottom of the running-alignment card (progress bar, Stop). Meaning: the alignment runs in the background; closing the popup or the page does not stop it. Length: medium.
settings.help.diagnostic: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Help & about › Help card, bold row title, with the 'Copy the report' button on the same line. Meaning: the diagnostic report (technical information for a bug report). Length: short, ≤ 26 chars.
settings.help.diagnosticHelp: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Help & about › Help card, grey text under 'Diagnostic report'. Meaning: what the report is for (paste it into a bug report) and what it contains: SyncKai version, browser, settings, latest errors; never sign-in tokens nor account names. Length: long, wraps.
settings.help.journalNote: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Help & about, grey note under the Help card while the error log is unfolded (list of errors with their time and module). Meaning: the log keeps at most the last 50 errors, shown newest first; sign-in tokens are masked before they are recorded. Length: medium, wraps.
settings.about.whatsNew: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Help & about › About card, link row (sparkles icon, 'synckai.app' on the right, opens the website's changelog in a new tab). Meaning: what changed in each version. Length: short.
settings.about.privacy: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Help & about › About card, link row (shield icon, opens the privacy policy in a new tab). Meaning: the privacy policy. Length: short.
